| [472](#pr-472) | Worn-accessory engine — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 29) | Merged · 2026-11-12 | ক্যাপ, সানগ্লাস, ঘড়ি আর ব্যাগের তৈরি করা ছবি এখন আসলেই রেকর্ড হয়। ঘড়ি, সানগ্লাস আর ব্যাগের জন্য আগে সেই ছবির সত্যিকারের রেফারেন্স ছবিতে লোগো/লেখার জায়গা মালিকের অনুমোদন করা থাকতে হবে — না থাকলে ছবি তৈরি হবে না; ক্যাপের জন্য এই বাধা নেই। কোনো দিকের (পরা বা রাখা) সত্যিকারের ছবি না থাকলে মালিককে স্পষ্ট করে বলা হয় কোন দিকের আরেকটা ছবি লাগবে। এর সাথে ক্যাপ-সানগ্লাস-ঘড়ি-ব্যাগের পুরো ব্যবস্থাটা শেষ হলো। |
| [473](#pr-473) | Reflective and transparent product handling (V1 C7.22 item 30) | Merged · 2026-11-12 | পারফিউমের বোতল, ঘড়ির কাঁচ আর সানগ্লাসের লেন্স — এই তিনটা জিনিস কখনো AI দিয়ে বানানো হয় না, কারণ কাঁচ, প্রতিফলন আর স্বচ্ছতা AI ভুল বানায়। বদলে মালিকের তোলা আসল ফোন-ছবিটাই রাখা হয় — ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড পরিষ্কার করে, ছায়া আর একটা নিয়ন্ত্রিত প্রতিফলন নতুন করে বসিয়ে, রং ঠিক করে, আর নির্দিষ্ট মাপে কেটে একটাই পরিষ্কার স্টুডিও ছবি তৈরি হয়। আসল ছবি না থাকলে মালিককে স্পষ্ট করে বলা হয় একটা ছবি দিতে — কিছুই বানিয়ে বলা হয় না। |

| [475](#pr-475) | Combo and gift-set composition studio (V1 C7.22 item 32) | Merged · 2026-11-12 | কম্বো বা গিফট সেটের একাধিক জিনিসের আগে-তোলা ছবি একসাথে সাজিয়ে একটা পূর্ণ স্টুডিও ছবি তৈরি করার ব্যবস্থা — দোকানের পাতার সাধারণ কোলাজ ছবি (PR 575) থেকে আলাদা, কারণ এখানে ছবিটা সাজিয়ে তোলা হয়। প্রতিটা জিনিসের নিজের একটা বাস্তব, যুক্ত করা ছবি আগে থেকেই থাকতে হবে — না থাকলে, বা সেটা মুছে ফেলা হয়ে থাকলে, কাজটা আটকে যাবে আর কোনটা বাদ পড়েছে তা বলে দেবে। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ আর ডিফল্ট সাজসজ্জা দিয়ে। |

| [477](#pr-477) | Set product type and two-garment try-on — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 34) | Merged · 2026-11-12 | ট্র্যাকসুট বা টপ-বটম সেটের জন্য "Set" নামের নতুন পণ্যের ধরন — আসলে নতুন কিছু বানানো হয়নি, কম্বো ব্যবস্থায় আগে থেকেই থাকা দুই-টুকরার TOP_BOTTOM কম্বোকেই এখন সেট হিসেবে ধরা হচ্ছে, যার টপ আর বটম দুটোই আলাদা SKU। একই মডেলের ছবিতে দুইবার বসিয়ে (আগে টপ, পরে বটম) পুরো সেট পরা একটাই ছবি তৈরির পরিকল্পনা — সামনে, তিন-চতুর্থাংশ, পিছনে আর হাঁটার ছবি — কিন্তু দুটো টুকরার আসল ছবি একসাথে না থাকলে কিছুই বানিয়ে বসানো হবে না, আর কোন অংশ বাকি আছে তা আলাদা করে বলে দেয়। সেটের নিজের ডিটেইল তালিকা (হুড-ড্রকর্ড, কাফ-রিব, জিপ-পুলার, সাইড স্ট্রাইপ, পকেট, অ্যাংকেল রিব, ওয়েস্টব্যান্ড ড্রকর্ড, ভিতরের ফ্লিস টেক্সচার) আগের Detail Finder ব্যবস্থাতেই যুক্ত হলো। এখনও কোনো ছবি রেকর্ড হয় না — সেটা পরের ধাপে (পার্ট ২)। |

## PR 444

**Asset model, role taxonomy, immutable originals, generated kept separate (V1 C7.22 item 1)**

**বাংলায়:** ফটোশুট স্টুডিওর ভিত্তি: আসল ছবি কখনো বদলায় বা মোছা হয় না, AI-তে বানানো ছবি সবসময় আলাদা সারিতে আর আসল ছবির সাথে লিংক করা থাকে; প্রতিটা রেফারেন্স ছবির ধরন (সামনে/পেছন/ডিটেইল) ঠিক করা থাকে; সত্যিকারের পেছনের ছবি না থাকলে পেছনের ছবি বানানো হয় না

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: asset model, role taxonomy, immutable originals, generated kept separate (S24 reopened, CN-039/CN-044 AI-2 lane; Blueprint C7.5 step 1, C7.6, V1 C7.22 item 1): new `@extas/photoshoot` package on the `MediaAsset.role`/`isOriginal`/`isAiGenerated`/`sourceAssetId` columns the S00 schema skeleton already carries (no migration). `roles.ts`: the fixed C7.6 taxonomy (`primary_garment`, `front_reference`, `side_reference`, `back_reference`, `detail_reference`, `context_reference`) and `hasBackReference` — the hard rule that a back view is never generated without a real, non-archived `back_reference` on file. `assets.ts`: `tagReferenceRole` (`photoshoot.write`) is the one allowed update to an existing original — only its `role` column, never its file/original fields; `recordGeneratedAsset` (`photoshoot.generate`) always creates a **new** row (`isOriginal: false`, `isAiGenerated: true`, `sourceAssetId` pointing at a real, verified original in the same store — refusing a missing source, one from another store, or one that is itself generated, so an AI image can never trace back to another AI image); `assertNoProtectedFieldChange` guards any future patch endpoint (PR 457's editor) against touching `isOriginal`/`sourceAssetId`/`isAiGenerated`/`storageKey`/`checksumSha256`. Permissions `photoshoot.read/write/generate/approve/publish` (catalogue.ts, additive, group `marketing`; approve/publish reserved for PR 458/480). No admin page yet (PR 445 adds the model library's). 15 new package tests (9 pure + 6 real-PostgreSQL: role tag persists and touches nothing else, unknown role and tagging a generated asset both refused, generated row linked back correctly, missing/foreign-store/already-generated source all refused, reader-vs-write/generate permission checks).
  - GitHub pull request #131, 11 Nov
- **What it does:** Asset model, role taxonomy, immutable originals, generated kept separate (V1 C7.22 item 1) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/photoshoot`, `roles.ts`, `assets.ts`, `photoshoot.read/write/generate/approve/publish`
  - Settings and named keys: `photoshoot.write`, `photoshoot.generate`
  - Names in the code: `MediaAsset.role`, `isOriginal`, `isAiGenerated`, `sourceAssetId`, `primary_garment`, `front_reference`, `side_reference`, `back_reference`, `detail_reference`, `context_reference`, `hasBackReference`, `tagReferenceRole`, `role`, `recordGeneratedAsset`, `isOriginal: false`, `isAiGenerated: true`, `assertNoProtectedFieldChange`, `storageKey`, `checksumSha256`, `marketing`
  - Tests: 15 new package tests (9 pure + 6 real-PostgreSQL: role tag persists and touches nothing else, unknown role and tagging a generated asset both refused, generated row linked back correctly, missing/foreign-store/already-generated source all refused, reader-vs-write/generate permission checks)
- **Owning agent:** Gyani
- **Mentions:** [PR 457](#pr-457), [PR 458](#pr-458), [PR 480](#pr-480), [PR 445](#pr-445)

## PR 445

## PR 450

**Provider adapter — part 2 (estimate, generate, status, fetch) (V1 C7.22 item 7)**

**বাংলায়:** FASHN AI আর Fitroom এখন আসল কাজের মেথড পেলো — খরচের হিসাব (দর না বসানো থাকলে অনুমান না করে 'জানা নেই' দেখায়), ছবি তৈরির অনুরোধ পাঠানো, অবস্থা জানা আর তৈরি ছবি আনা। প্র্যাকটিস provider-ও একই কাজ নকলে করে দেখায়। এখনো সত্যিকারের key দিয়ে কোনো ছবি তৈরি হয়নি — শুধু ভিত্তি তৈরি হলো, ব্যবস্থাপনার কাজ (queue, পুনরায় চেষ্টা) পরের PR-এ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: provider adapter, part 2: estimate/generate/status/fetch (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 7, C7.6 "cost shown before a batch", C7.19's "headline metric: cost per approved image"; registry v289 `registry-photoshoot-cost.ts`, `studio.photoshoot.rates` — paisa per approved image per provider and tier, 0/not set by default, CN-018; FIX lane: bumped from this branch's own v288 to v289, since PR 447's unrelated `registry-photoshoot.ts` landed first at v288): `PhotoshootProviderApi` (`contract.ts`) grows four methods every provider now answers — `estimate` (pure arithmetic on the owner's own rate, `null` when it is still 0, never an invented cost), `generate` (submits one try-on or ghost-mannequin job), `status` (polls, normalised to `queued`/`processing`/`succeeded`/`failed`, never downloads the output) and `fetch` (reads back a succeeded job's output URLs once, for the caller to download and re-store at once). FASHN: `POST /v1/run` with `{model_name, inputs: {model_image, garment_image, category, seed, num_samples}}`, `GET /v1/status/{id}` mapping its five real status strings, a completed job's spend from the `x-fashn-credits-used` response header (never invented when absent). Fitroom: `POST /api/tryon/v2/tasks` as **multipart form data** — the adapter itself fetches the garment/model image bytes before building the form, since Fitroom takes files, not URLs — `cloth_type` from an explicit top/bottom/one_piece category (Fitroom has no "auto"), `GET /api/tryon/v2/tasks/:id` for status/progress and the temporary `download_signed_url` once `COMPLETED`. Both providers' and the practice provider's `generate` refuse up front (no network call) when the job kind is outside the connected provider's own capabilities (`requirePhotoshootJobSupported`) or a required image is missing — the C7.6 "never invent a back view" spirit applied one level down, to the job call itself. The mock encodes its whole round trip in the job id itself (no database here) and, honestly, hands back the garment shot as its own "output" rather than fabricating one (the PR 439/440 rule). 26 new tests (`photoshoot-provider.test.ts`, now 41), a new settings test (`registry-photoshoot-cost.test.ts`) and its English/Bengali labels (`messages/photoshoot-cost.{en,bn}.json`) — all against stand-in servers, never the real network or a real key. No new admin page; no job orchestration yet (queue, retries, idempotency) — that is PR 451–452.

## PR 451

**Job orchestration: queue, state machine, idempotency — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 8)**

**বাংলায়:** ছবি তৈরির অনুরোধের জন্য একটা queue সারি আর তার অবস্থার নিয়ম (draft → queued → processing → review_required → approved → published, নাকচ/ব্যর্থ/বাতিলও আছে)। একই অনুরোধ দুবার এলে নতুন job না খুলে পুরোনোটাই দেখায় — দুবার খরচ হয় না। এখনো কোনো provider-কে ডাকা হয় না, সেটা পরের PR-এ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: job orchestration, part 1: queue, state machine, idempotency (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 7, C7.6 "draft → queued → processing → review_required → approved → published, plus rejected, failed, cancelled" — this PR's own `JOB_TRANSITIONS` graph; "no double charging" — the DB's `PhotoshootJob.@@unique([storeId, idempotencyKey])` already in the S00 schema skeleton, now actually used): new `packages/photoshoot/src/jobs.ts` — `computeIdempotencyKey` (a deterministic sha256 fingerprint of product/colour/recipe/model/scene/angle/tier/input-assets/seed, asset-id order and an omitted-vs-explicit-null field both ignored) so a resent request lands on the same row instead of a second one; `isValidJobTransition` (pure, against `JOB_TRANSITIONS`) so neither a staff action nor the job runner can skip a step; `createOrReuseJob` (`photoshoot.generate`, validates the product and every input asset are this store's own, opens the row `DRAFT` then `QUEUED`, or hands back the existing row on an exact repeat); `transitionJob` (store-scoped, checks the graph before checking permission — `photoshoot.approve` into/out of the review queue, `photoshoot.publish` to go live, `photoshoot.write` to cancel, `photoshoot.generate` for the runner's own `PROCESSING`/`REVIEW_REQUIRED`/`FAILED` reports and for the one retry edge `FAILED -> QUEUED`, which clears the old error and bumps `attempt`), audited on every move. Also carried forward into this branch (it combines the 444–448 and 449–450 lineages, which until now never shared one): PR 444's five `photoshoot.*` permission keys into `packages/auth/src/catalogue.ts` and their English/Bengali labels — present in 444–448's own branch all along, never needed by 449/450's unrelated adapters work. Deliberately not here: actually calling a provider adapter's `generate`/`status`/`fetch` (PR 449–450), retrying with a new seed, concurrency limiting, the spend cap (C7.20) — all PR 452 and later. 25 new pure tests (`jobs.test.ts`) and 9 DB-backed tests (`jobs.db.test.ts`, skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI). No new admin page.

  - Names in the code: `JOB_TRANSITIONS`, `PhotoshootJob.@@unique([storeId, idempotencyKey])`, `computeIdempotencyKey`, `isValidJobTransition`, `createOrReuseJob`, `DRAFT`, `QUEUED`, `transitionJob`, `PROCESSING`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `FAILED`, `FAILED -> QUEUED`, `attempt`, `generate`, `status`, `fetch`

## PR 452

**Job orchestration: per-view retry, concurrency, spend caps — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 9)**

**বাংলায়:** ব্যর্থ হলে একটা নতুন seed দিয়ে আবার চেষ্টা (ঠিক সেই একই ছবি view-টার জন্যই, পুরো পণ্যের জন্য না); দোকানের নিজের একটা সীমা — একসাথে কতটা কাজ আসলে চলতে পারবে (শুরুতে কোনো সীমা নেই); আর Photoshoot এজেন্টের মাসিক খরচের সীমা ছুঁলে নতুন কাজ থেমে যায় (যা অনুমোদিত হয়েছে তা দোকানে থাকেই, কিছু হারায় না)। এখনো কোনো provider আসলে ডাকা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: job orchestration, part 2: per-view retry with a new seed, concurrency limiting, the spend cap (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 7 "retried with a different seed on failure", C7.20; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451, built straight on its tip; no migration — `PhotoshootJob.attempt`/`.seed`, `AiAgent.monthlyCapMinor`, `AiUsageLedger` all already in the schema; registry v290 `registry-photoshoot-queue.ts`, `studio.photoshoot.maxConcurrentJobs` — 0/unlimited by default, CN-018): `packages/photoshoot/src/jobs.ts`'s `transitionJob` now draws a fresh seed on every `FAILED -> QUEUED` move (`nextDifferentSeed`, bounded retry against the previous seed, `deps.randomSeed` injectable for tests, real crypto bytes otherwise) — baked into the primitive itself so the "different seed" guarantee holds for any caller, not only the new named `retryFailedJob` wrapper (C7.5 step 7: "retry only the failed or rejected view, never the whole product" — one job, by its own id). New gated `startProcessing` is the one sanctioned entry into `PROCESSING` — the moment a job is about to actually spend by calling a provider adapter's `generate` (PR 449–450) — checking this store's own `studio.photoshoot.maxConcurrentJobs` and the Photoshoot agent's monthly spend cap before letting the move happen; either refusal (`CONCURRENCY_LIMIT`, `SPEND_CAP_REACHED`, both 429) leaves the job exactly `QUEUED`, nothing lost or failed, matching C7.20's "new generations pause... the shop is unaffected." New `packages/photoshoot/src/spendCap.ts`: `agentCapState` deliberately duplicates PR 309's own C1.6 arithmetic (a package cannot depend on `apps/web`) and reads the one shared `AiUsageLedger` by an `AiAgent` row keyed `photoshoot` — honestly a no-op (never blocks) until a later PR (S24 item 25, AI 360 wiring) seeds that row, the same "ships off, CN-018" pattern PR 450's rate setting used. 13 new pure tests (`jobs.test.ts`'s `nextDifferentSeed`, `spendCap.test.ts`'s `agentCapState`/`monthStart`, kept identical to PR 309's own table) and 8 new DB-backed tests (`jobs.db.test.ts`, skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI), including the concurrency gate on its own isolated store so an earlier test's leftover `PROCESSING` rows never leak into the count, and the cap gate reaching "paused" mid-test by adding ledger spend to the same agent row. Deliberately not here: actually calling the provider adapter itself (the runner/worker's own job), best-of-2 (PR 453), the cost ledger's reuse rules (S24 item 16). No new admin page; no admin-guide change (none exists yet for S24, same as PR 451).
- **What it does:** Job orchestration: per-view retry, concurrency, spend caps — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 9) (derived)

  - Settings and named keys: `studio.photoshoot.maxConcurrentJobs`, `deps.randomSeed`

  - Tests: 13 new pure tests (`jobs.test.ts`'s `nextDifferentSeed`, `spendCap.test.ts`'s `agentCapState`/`monthStart`, kept identical to PR 309's own table) and 8 new DB-backed tests (`jobs.db.test.ts`, skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI), including the concurrency gate on its own isolated store so an earlier test's leftover `PROCESSING` rows never leak into the count, and the cap gate reaching "paused" mid-test by adding ledger spend to the same agent row

## PR 453

**Best-of-2 plus automatic scoring (V1 C7.22 item 10)**

**বাংলায়:** দুটো ছবি তৈরি করে (best-of-2) প্রতিটার মান স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে মাপা হয় (পোশাকের আকৃতি, প্রিন্ট, রঙ, হাত/আঙুল, কিনারা, সেলাই) — সবচেয়ে ভালোটাই মালিকের দেখার তালিকায় যায়, বাকিটা রাখা থাকে শুধু রেকর্ডের জন্য। সবচেয়ে ভালোটাও মালিকের বসানো সর্বনিম্ন মানের নিচে থাকলে কাউকেই দেখানো হয় না — কাজটা তখন ব্যর্থ ধরা হয়, যাতে নতুন seed দিয়ে আবার চেষ্টা করা যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: best-of-2 plus automatic scoring (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 9 "garment shape integrity, print legibility, colour difference vs the original, hand/finger artefacts, edge quality, seam continuity. Anything below threshold never reaches a human", C7.7 "Best-of-2, not best-of-4"; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–452; no migration — `PhotoshootOutput` already in the schema; registry v291 `registry-photoshoot-quality.ts`, `studio.photoshoot.qualityThresholdPercent` — 0/never-auto-rejects by default, CN-018): new `packages/photoshoot/src/outputs.ts` — the six C7.5 step 9 dimensions as a fixed, documented 0 (worst)–1 (best) convention (`QUALITY_METRIC_KEYS`, `qualityScoresSchema`; no CV/scoring model is wired yet, exactly PR 450's honest scope for the provider adapters — a later PR fills in the real scorer, inverting its own raw measurement into this convention first); `combinedScorePercent` (the plain unweighted mean, as a whole percent) and `passesQualityThreshold`; `pickBestCandidate` (the highest-scoring of up to two, a tie keeping the lowest index — deterministic). `recordScoredOutputs` is the runner's own report of what a provider generated for one `PROCESSING` job: validates every candidate's asset is this store's own AI-generated image (never an original), scores each, and keeps exactly one — the winner — for the review queue (`PhotoshootOutput.reviewStatus`: `PENDING` for the winner when it clears the cut-off, `NOT_SELECTED` for the other candidate, `AUTO_REJECTED` when even the winner does not clear it); moves the job to `REVIEW_REQUIRED` on a winner, or to `FAILED` (eligible for PR 452's `retryFailedJob`, a fresh seed and all) when nothing clears the cut-off. The job's own `PROCESSING`-only precondition doubles as the idempotency guard — a repeat report finds the job already moved on and refuses, so it can never record a second batch of outputs for one run. Refuses more than two candidates outright ("best-of-2, not best-of-4", C7.7). 11 new pure tests (`outputs.test.ts`) and 7 new DB-backed tests (`outputs.db.test.ts`, skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI). No new admin page; the review/approval UI itself (side by side, with reasons) is PR 458.
- **What it does:** Best-of-2 plus automatic scoring (V1 C7.22 item 10) (derived)

  - Settings and named keys: `studio.photoshoot.qualityThresholdPercent`

## PR 454

**Detail re-projection for logos and prints (V1 C7.22 item 11)**

**বাংলায়:** লোগো বা প্রিন্টের আসল, উঁচু-মানের ছবিটা মালিকের অনুমোদন পেলে তৈরি করা মডেলের ছবির উপর বসিয়ে দেওয়া হয়, যাতে লোগো-প্রিন্ট AI-তে ঘেঁটে না যায় — আসলটার মতোই স্পষ্ট থাকে। মালিক আগে নিশ্চিত না করলে কিছুই বসানো হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: detail re-projection for logos and prints (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 8 "Logos, prints, embroidery and text are exactly where these models fail. After generation, the original high-resolution texture of the print/logo region is warped and composited back over the generated garment … the single biggest fidelity lever in the whole module"; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–453; no migration — `DetailRegion` already in the schema, built for exactly this and shared with PR 463–464's own later, unrelated use of the same bbox shape on a finished image): new `packages/photoshoot/src/detailRegions.ts` — `DETAIL_REGION_KINDS` (logo/print/embroidery/text/label, a fixed data-model vocabulary like the asset roles, never a setting) and a normalised 0–1 `bboxSchema`; `recordDetailRegion` (`photoshoot.write`) marks a region on a real, original reference photo only — never on a generated image, the same one-way rule PR 444 already enforces — starting `approved: false`; `approveDetailRegion` (`photoshoot.approve`) is the owner's own confirmation a detected region really is the logo/print it claims to be, applying C7.6's "mandatory review" rule one step earlier than the output queue; `planDetailReprojection` (pure) mirrors the ghost-mannequin engine's own "never invent" shape (PR 446) — not ready, and nothing warped, until at least one approved region is on file; `recordDetailReprojectionOutput` (`photoshoot.generate`) records the finished composite through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset`, tracing back to the real reference photo the region lives on (never to the generated candidate it enhances — a generated image must always trace to a real one) and carrying the candidate's own id in `tags` (`reprojectedCandidateId` reads it back) so a reviewer can always find which on-model render this refines. No warp/composite algorithm is wired yet — exactly PR 450's and PR 453's own honest scope for their own unbuilt pieces; `detectedBy` stays `'manual'` until a later PR adds an automatic detector. 11 new pure tests (`detailRegions.test.ts`) and 12 new DB-backed tests (`detailRegions.db.test.ts`, skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI). No new admin page; the region-marking UI itself is a later PR, same as the review queue (PR 458).

## PR 458

**Review and approval UI with side-by-side and reasons (V1 C7.22 item 15)**

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: review and approval UI with side-by-side and reasons (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.5 step 10 "the owner sees generated vs original side by side and approves, rejects or regenerates", C7.16 "Review and approval UI — side by side, with reasons on rejection"; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–457; no migration — `PhotoshootOutput.reviewStatus`/`.rejectReason`/`.reviewedById`/`.reviewedAt` already in the schema, the schema's own comment naming this PR for exactly this): grows PR 453's own `packages/photoshoot/src/outputs.ts` in place (the same pattern PR 452 used on `jobs.ts`, PR 456 on `finishing.ts`) with `decideOutputReview` (`photoshoot.approve`) — the owner's own decision on a `PENDING` output: refuses a decision on anything not `PENDING` (never a silent overwrite of a past decision, never a decision on a `NOT_SELECTED`/`AUTO_REJECTED` candidate nobody was shown), and a rejection with no reason is refused outright by the input schema itself ("with reasons on rejection"); approving/rejecting moves the output and, through `transitionJob`, its job together to `APPROVED`/`REJECTED`. `listReviewQueue` (`photoshoot.read`) is every `REVIEW_REQUIRED` job with its one `PENDING` output, oldest-waiting first. New admin screens: the queue `/admin/marketing/photoshoot/review` and the side-by-side decision page `/admin/marketing/photoshoot/review/[jobId]` (real original vs. generated image, Approve / Reject-with-reason), wired through a new `POST /api/admin/marketing/photoshoot-review` route; hidden from the menu by `stages.closedShown.S24` until the stage finishes and is gated, same as every other S24 screen. ## PR 459

**Cost ledger, estimates, caps, reuse rules (V1 C7.22 item 16)**

**বাংলায়:** ছবি তৈরির আগে খরচের আন্দাজ দেখা যায় (আপনার নিজের হার থেকে, রেট না দিলে কোনো সংখ্যা বানানো হয় না)। একই রকম অনুরোধ আগে একবার মানা হয়ে থাকলে আর নতুন করে টাকা খরচ হয় না — আগের মানা ছবিটাই ফিরে আসে। আর যে ছবি আসলেই তৈরি হলো তার সত্যিকারের খরচ হিসাবের খাতায় লেখা হয়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: cost ledger, estimates and the reuse rule (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.6 "Reuse approved outputs unless the source image, the model, the settings or the provider version changed … Cost shown before a batch: product count, views, tier, estimate, retry buffer, hard spend cap … no double charging", C7.19 "cost per approved image", B3.9 "Cost ledger — core, must not be forgotten"; registry v289 `registry-photoshoot-cost.ts`, `studio.photoshoot.rates` already live since PR 450; no migration — `PhotoshootJob.reuseHash`/`.estimateMinor`/`.actualMinor` and `CostEntry` already in the schema, built for exactly this; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–458; `@extas/photoshoot` keeps its own no-dependency-on-`@extas/adapters` boundary, duplicating the provider-key vocabulary and estimate arithmetic as a plain, pure function rather than cross-importing, the same choice PR 452's `spendCap.ts` already made at this package edge): new `packages/photoshoot/src/costLedger.ts` — `PHOTOSHOOT_PROVIDERS`/`isPhotoshootProvider`; `estimateGenerationCostMinor` (the owner's own rate × image count, `null` for the free practice provider, for a non-positive count and whenever the owner has not set a rate yet — 0, CN-018, never an invented number); `imageCountForTier` (1 for baseline, 2 for premium's best-of-2, C7.7); `computeReuseHash` (deliberately broader than the idempotency key — no seed — a sha256 fingerprint of product/colour/recipe/model/scene/angle/tier/inputs/provider/providerVersion); `recordGenerationCostEntry` writes one `CostEntry` row and trues up the job's own `actualMinor`, skipped outright for the practice provider or an unset rate. Grows PR 451's `createOrReuseJob` (same "grow in place" pattern as PR 452/456/458) with an optional `provider`/`providerVersion`: when named, the exact-repeat idempotency key now folds `provider` in too (two requests differing only by provider never collide), the new row's own estimate is read from the owner's own rates, and — ahead of the exact-repeat check — an existing `APPROVED`/`PUBLISHED` job with the same reuse fingerprint is returned as-is (`reusedApproval: true`) instead of opening a new one, C7.6's reuse rule. Grows PR 453/458's `recordScoredOutputs` to write the real `CostEntry` at scoring time, against the real candidate count actually produced — not the job's open-time estimate — since the provider is charged regardless of the owner's later review decision. Entirely additive and backward compatible: every existing caller that never names a provider is unaffected (verified: full pre-existing suite still green). 12 new pure tests (`costLedger.test.ts`) plus 2 new pure tests and one DB test file extended in `jobs.test.ts`/`jobs.db.test.ts` for the provider-aware idempotency key and the reuse rule, and 6 new DB tests extending PR 453/458's own `outputs.db.test.ts` for the cost-ledger write (all DB-backed tests skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI). No new admin page. Deliberately NOT here: trueing the estimate up against a provider's own *reported* credits (`PhotoshootFetchResult.creditsUsed`, PR 449–450) — that needs the job runner that actually calls a provider's `fetch`, still unbuilt; the recommendation-note system is PR 460.
- **What it does:** Cost ledger, estimates, caps, reuse rules (V1 C7.22 item 16) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `registry-photoshoot-cost.ts`, `@extas/photoshoot`, `@extas/adapters`, `spendCap.ts`, `packages/photoshoot/src/costLedger.ts`, `costLedger.test.ts`, `jobs.test.ts`, `jobs.db.test.ts`, `outputs.db.test.ts`
  - Settings and named keys: `studio.photoshoot.rates`
  - Names in the code: `PhotoshootJob.reuseHash`, `.estimateMinor`, `.actualMinor`, `CostEntry`, `PHOTOSHOOT_PROVIDERS`, `isPhotoshootProvider`, `estimateGenerationCostMinor`, `null`, `imageCountForTier`, `computeReuseHash`, `recordGenerationCostEntry`, `actualMinor`, `createOrReuseJob`, `provider`, `providerVersion`, `APPROVED`, `PUBLISHED`, `reusedApproval: true`, `recordScoredOutputs`, `PhotoshootFetchResult.creditsUsed`, `fetch`
  - Tests: 12 new pure tests (`costLedger.test.ts`) plus 2 new pure tests and one DB test file extended in `jobs.test.ts`/`jobs.db.test.ts` for the provider-aware idempotency key and the reuse rule, and 6 new DB tests extending PR 453/458's own `outputs.db.test.ts` for the cost-ledger write (all DB-backed tests skipped here — no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI)

## PR 460

**Recommendation-note system (V1 C7.22 item 17)**

**বাংলায়:** আপনি কোন প্রোভাইডার বেছে নিলেন তা কখনো বদলে দেওয়া হয় না — শুধু একটা সৎ নোট দেখানো হয়: সিস্টেমের নিজের পরামর্শের তুলনায় আসল খরচের পার্থক্য কত। মান (quality) নিয়ে কোনো দাবি করা হয় না, সেটা আসল পরীক্ষা ছাড়া বলা সম্ভব না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: recommendation-note system (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.5 "recommendation notes: Claude's choice is always the default … an inline note immediately explains the effect", C7.20 "the recommendation note when the owner changes one", C7.19 "A/B the providers on 20 real products before committing"; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–459; no migration, nothing persisted — the note is computed fresh every time from the owner's own `studio.photoshoot.rates`, the same way PR 459's `estimateMinor` already is): new `packages/photoshoot/src/recommendation.ts` — `PHOTOSHOOT_PROVIDER_RECOMMENDATION_ORDER` (FASHN before Fitroom, mirroring C7.17's own listing order — a tie-break only, never a claimed quality edge); `recommendedPhotoshootProvider` (the first rated provider the owner has actually set any real rate for, `null` when none is configured yet — nothing invented, CN-018); `photoshootRecommendationNote` applies the exact same honest "recommendation note" pattern PR 307 built for per-agent model selection (C1.5) to the photoshoot provider choice: the owner's own pick is never overridden, only explained — `null` for the free practice provider, when nothing is configured to recommend against, or when the choice already matches the suggestion; otherwise a real cost-in-paisa comparison (or an honest "no rate set yet, so no comparison is possible" when either side's rate is still 0) that always closes on the same disclaimer — quality is never compared, since only the real A/B pilot on 20 real products (C7.19) answers that. Wired into PR 451/459's own `createOrReuseJob`, which now always returns a `recommendationNote` field alongside the job (computed once, reused across every return path — a fresh job, an exact-repeat reuse, and the C7.6 reuse-rule hit alike) — purely additive, no behaviour change for a caller that ignores the new field. 14 new pure tests (`recommendation.test.ts`) and 3 new DB-backed tests extending PR 451/459's own `jobs.db.test.ts` (null on every "nothing to say" case, a real cost delta on the non-suggested rated provider, the note surviving all three return paths) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI (`@extas/photoshoot` 134 pure tests passing + 110 DB-only skipped). No new admin page — no S24 screen yet reads this result at all; whichever later PR builds the batch-cost preview gets the note for free. Deliberately NOT here: the AI Cost Book row itself (C7.20's own larger ask — S15, PR 312/580, still unbuilt) and any admin screen to show the note; the front-end gallery is PR 461.

## PR 461

**Front-end gallery, angle switcher, zoom, disclosure line (V1 C7.22 item 18)**

**বাংলায়:** পণ্যের ছবির গ্যালারিতে এখন আসল সামনের ছবি আগে, তারপর মডেলে পরা ছবি, পেছনের ছবি, কাপড়ের কাছ থেকে ছবি — এই ক্রমে দেখায়। জুম করলে বড়, স্পষ্ট ছবি আসে, আর রঙ বদলালে সাথে সাথে সেই রঙের ছবিগুলো দেখা যায়, নতুন করে কিছু বানাতে হয় না। পণ্যের বিবরণে একটা সৎ লাইন থাকে — কিছু ছবিতে পোশাকটা কম্পিউটারে মডেলের গায়ে বসানো, কাপড় আর রঙের আসল ছবি আলাদাভাবে বলা থাকে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: front-end gallery, angle switcher, zoom, disclosure line (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.15 "Front end": "On-model images are part of the normal gallery, with the same zoom; the high-resolution version loads on zoom" · "Angle switcher — front / three-quarter / back / walking / seated — sharing the garment's colour selection; changing colour re-renders the whole set from the pre-generated cache, instantly" · "Gallery order: real front shot → on-model views → back → fabric close-up → detail" · "one honest line in the product details" on disclosure; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–460; no migration, no admin page — this is the storefront side, PR 54/50/51/88's own long-standing PDP gallery, grown in place, never rewritten): investigated first, as the predecessor's own handback flagged — the PDP gallery (`apps/web/src/lib/shop/pdp-gallery.ts`, `PdpGallery.tsx`, `PdpZoom.tsx`, `ShotPicture.tsx`) already does three of C7.15's four asks, by construction, from PR 54/88: an on-model (`ON_MODEL` → kind `'model'`) photo is already an ordinary gallery shot with the same strip/arrows/thumbnails/zoom; `media.image.slots.zoom` already serves the largest rendition only inside the full-screen viewer (high-res-on-zoom); and `PdpModel.shots` is already built once per page load, every colour at once (PR 49/54) — a colour change only switches which pre-built array the gallery shows, so "re-render from the pre-generated cache, instantly" already holds with zero new code. What was missing: the canonical order itself, and a way to tell two on-model photos apart. New in `pdp-gallery.ts`: `withOnModelOrder` — once a colour's shots include an on-model photo, sorts the whole list into C7.15's own order (front → model → back → fabric → detail → everything else, stable so two same-kind shots never swap); a colour with no on-model photo is untouched, byte for byte — PR 54's own "owner's order" promise, and its own tests, stay exactly as they were, so today's plain photo shops never see a pixel of change. Wired into `shotsFor` itself, so every caller gets it for free. `onModelAngles` — labels each on-model shot by its position among the colour's own on-model shots, using C7.15's own five names (front/three-quarter/back/walking/seated, the same vocabulary `@extas/photoshoot`'s PR 445 `MODEL_ANGLES` already uses for a model's reference photos); a sixth-or-later on-model shot, or any non-model shot, stays unlabelled rather than guess. Deliberately no new switcher widget: the demo (`EXTAS-demo-V12.4.html`) draws no separate angle-switcher control, and C7.15 itself says on-model images use "the same zoom" as everything else — the existing strip, arrows and thumbnails already move between every on-model shot; `onModelAngles` only makes `PdpGallery.tsx`/`PdpZoom.tsx` announce each one by its own angle (aria-label and alt text) instead of all of them sounding like one generic "On model photo", so the phone UI matches the demo exactly, pixel for pixel, while two different angles are no longer indistinguishable to a screen reader. A honest limit, left for whoever builds the photoshoot→`ProductMedia` publish step: `ProductMediaRole` has one `ON_MODEL` value with no angle column, so today an on-model shot's angle is read from its position only, not a stored fact — correct once the admin/publish flow uploads angles in C7.15's own order (as it already must, for `withOnModelOrder` to do anything), wrong only if that order is ever broken by hand. New dict keys in both `messages/shop.en.json` and `messages/shop.bn.json`: `pdp.view.modelAngle.{front,threeQuarter,back,walking,seated}` and `pdp.galleryDisclosure` ("Some pictures show the garment placed on a model by computer; the fabric and colour photos are the real ones" / its Bengali line) — no "AI" badge anywhere, exactly C7.15's own instruction. The disclosure line renders once, in `ProductPage.tsx`, next to the details accordions, only on a page where some colour actually has an on-model shot (`Object.values(m.shots).some(list => list.some(s => s.kind === 'model'))`) — a plain product never shows it. 9 new pure tests extending PR 54's own `pdp-gallery.test.ts` (the untouched-order guarantee, the canonical reorder, a stable sort, the same behaviour through `shotsFor` itself, the five angle labels, the sixth-shot and no-on-model cases); the whole pre-existing `apps/web` test suite (93 files, 585 tests) stays green. Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`, 8 GB heap — the repo's whole-project typecheck needs more than Node's 2 GB default; this sandbox's `apps/web/src/generated/status.json` was regenerated locally with `tools/make-status.mjs` first, same as CI's build step already does, since it is build-time output, never committed) and lint clean on every touched file; hardcode guard 0/3212 files; `admin-guide-check` clean (no admin page touched, so nothing to guide). Deliberately NOT here: the photoshoot→`ProductMedia` publish step itself (still unbuilt anywhere in S24 444–460 — a photoshoot-approved image reaches the gallery today the same way any photo does, through the existing admin media attach/reorder screen), and any change to `ProductMediaRole` or the Prisma schema (CLAUDE.md: the schema has one owner, not this lane).
- **What it does:** Front-end gallery, angle switcher, zoom, disclosure line (V1 C7.22 item 18) (derived)

## PR 462

**Pilot harness and metrics (cost per approved image, first-pass rate) plus live A/B (V1 C7.22 item 19)**

**বাংলায়:** স্টুডিওর ফলাফল মাপার ব্যবস্থা তৈরি হলো — মালিক দেখতে পারবেন প্রতিটা মানসম্মত (approved) ছবির আসল খরচ কত, প্রথমবারেই কত ছবি পাস হয়, আর কতটা সময় লাগে। পাশাপাশি আসল সাইটে মডেলে-পরা বনাম সমান-করে-রাখা ছবির একটা পরীক্ষা চালানোর ব্যবস্থা হলো — কোনো পণ্যে চালু হবে না যতক্ষণ না মালিক নিজে কিছু পণ্য বেছে দেন; তখন কাস্টমাররা ভাগ হয়ে যাবেন, আর বিক্রি-ফেরত-ঝুড়িতে-তোলার হিসাব দুই দলের মধ্যে তুলনা করে দেখানো হবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: pilot harness and metrics, plus the live on-model-vs-flat-lay A/B (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.19 "run 20–30 real EXTAS products through two providers … put the results in front of the owner … A/B test on-model vs flat-lay on the live site, measuring add-to-bag, conversion and return rate … Headline metric: cost per APPROVED image, not per generated image, plus first-pass approval rate, retries per approved image, processing time, failure rate and review time. Scale only on the numbers", C7.20; registry v292 `registry-photoshoot-pilot.ts`; migration 0188 — the one new table this PR genuinely needed, not anticipated by the S00 schema skeleton the way `StudioPilotRun` was (its own doc comment already named this PR); same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–461): new `packages/photoshoot/src/pilotMetrics.ts` — `aggregatePilotMetrics` (pure) reads one period's `PhotoshootJob`/`PhotoshootOutput` rows and answers every C7.19 number (cost per approved image off real `actualMinor` spend — never per generated candidate; first-pass approval rate and retries per approved image off `attempt`; processing time off `startedAt`/`finishedAt`; failure rate off a terminal-status share that excludes `DRAFT`/`QUEUED`/`PROCESSING`/`CANCELLED`; review time off `PhotoshootOutput.reviewedAt − createdAt`) — every rate `null`, never 0 or invented, with an empty denominator (CN-018); `computePilotMetrics` (`photoshoot.read`) fetches the period and calls it; `recordPilotRun` (`photoshoot.write`) additionally snapshots the result as one append-only `StudioPilotRun` row (the schema's own three named columns plus the rest in `metrics` JSON) — C7.19's "put the results in front of the owner," re-runnable per provider without ever overwriting an earlier snapshot; `listPilotRuns` reads them back. New `packages/photoshoot/src/styleAbTest.ts` — the live pilot itself, on a genuinely new table (`PhotoshootStyleTrial`, migration 0188, reusing `ProductMediaRole`'s own `ON_MODEL`/`FLAT_LAY` values rather than a parallel vocabulary) deliberately kept separate from the generic storefront `AbTest`/`AbAssignment` pair (S02, PR 83): that engine's `variants`/`goalEvent` shape is fixed to word/eye-toggle changes and a single addToBag-or-order goal, and the owner's Reports › Experiments screen lists every `AbTest` row as one of those, so a differently-shaped row there would show up broken rather than staying the pilot's own thing. `bucketStyleVariant` (pure, sha256-based, deterministic — the same visitor always lands the same side) and `assignStyleVariant` — deliberately NOT gated behind a staff `Who`/`allow()` the way everything else in this package is, since it is meant for the storefront's own visitor-facing code (not wired to a real PDP route in this PR — see below), the same way the shop's cart tables are written with no staff permission; reads the owner's own `studio.photoshoot.styleAbTest.productIds` cohort (empty, as it ships — CN-018, no pilot runs until the owner picks the 20–30 real products C7.19 names), finds-or-creates the one trial row a visitor+product will ever get (retried once on the unique-index race, the same `P2002`-retry pattern `@extas/customers`' `addNoteOrTag` already uses). `styleTallies` (`photoshoot.read`) reads real `CartItem`/`Order`/`OrderItem`/`ReturnRecord`/`ReturnItem` rows, scoped to after each trial's own `createdAt`, for add-to-bag/order/return counts per variant; `twoProportionVerdict` duplicates — never imports — the exact two-proportion z-test S02's own `apps/web/src/lib/experiments/model.ts` already built (`@extas/photoshoot` must not depend on `apps/web`, the same boundary `spendCap.ts`/`costLedger.ts` already draw), deliberately carrying no "winner" field: C7.19 asks for three outcomes at once, and a lower rate is the good result for returns, so the caller — not this function — decides which direction it wanted. `StudioPilotRun`/`AbAssignment`-style personal data classified in `schema-meta.ts`'s `APPEND_ONLY_OPEN` (`PhotoshootStyleTrial`, reason `PERSONAL`, same bucket as `AbAssignment`). 22 new pure tests (`pilotMetrics.test.ts`, `styleAbTest.test.ts` — the arithmetic, the deterministic bucket, the confidence math) and 15 new DB-backed tests (`pilotMetrics.db.test.ts`, `styleAbTest.db.test.ts`: period windows, store scoping, permission checks, the append-only snapshot, the cohort gate, the unique-index race, the real add-to-bag/order/return join — skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI). `@extas/db` 248 tests, `@extas/settings` 4824 tests and `@extas/photoshoot` 156 pure tests (now 125 DB-only skipped) all stay green; `apps/web` whole-project typecheck (8 GB heap) clean. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here: the actual PDP route that calls `assignStyleVariant` and swaps the gallery's lead image per visitor (touches `apps/web`'s PdpGallery under the phone pixel-diff gate — a later PR's own honest scope, the same shape every prior S24 piece left for its unbuilt neighbour) and any admin screen to read `listPilotRuns`/`styleTallies` back.
- **What it does:** Pilot harness and metrics (cost per approved image, first-pass rate) plus live A/B (V1 C7.22 item 19) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `registry-photoshoot-pilot.ts`, `packages/photoshoot/src/pilotMetrics.ts`, `packages/photoshoot/src/styleAbTest.ts`, `@extas/customers`, `apps/web/src/lib/experiments/model.ts`, `@extas/photoshoot`, `apps/web`, `spendCap.ts`, `costLedger.ts`, `schema-meta.ts`, `pilotMetrics.test.ts`, `styleAbTest.test.ts`, `pilotMetrics.db.test.ts`, `styleAbTest.db.test.ts`, `@extas/db`, `@extas/settings`
  - Settings and named keys: `photoshoot.read`, `photoshoot.write`, `studio.photoshoot.styleAbTest.productIds`
  - Names in the code: `StudioPilotRun`, `aggregatePilotMetrics`, `PhotoshootJob`, `PhotoshootOutput`, `actualMinor`, `attempt`, `startedAt`, `finishedAt`, `DRAFT`, `QUEUED`, `PROCESSING`, `CANCELLED`, `PhotoshootOutput.reviewedAt − createdAt`, `null`, `computePilotMetrics`, `recordPilotRun`, `metrics`, `listPilotRuns`, `PhotoshootStyleTrial`, `ProductMediaRole`, `ON_MODEL`, `FLAT_LAY`, `AbTest`, `AbAssignment`, `variants`, `goalEvent`, `bucketStyleVariant`, `assignStyleVariant`, `Who`, `allow()`, `P2002`, `addNoteOrTag`, `styleTallies`, `CartItem`, `Order`, `OrderItem`, `ReturnRecord`, `ReturnItem`, `createdAt`, `twoProportionVerdict`, `APPEND_ONLY_OPEN`, `PERSONAL`

  - Tests: `twoProportionVerdict` duplicates — never imports — the exact two-proportion z-test S02's own `apps/web/src/lib/experiments/model.ts` already built (`@extas/photoshoot` must not depend on `apps/web`, the same boundary `spendCap.ts`/`costLedger.ts` already draw), deliberately carrying no "winner" field: C7.19 asks for three outcomes at once, and a lower rate is the good result for returns, so the caller — not this function — decides which direction it wanted

## PR 463

**Detail finder — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 20)**

**বাংলায়:** পোশাকের ছোট ছোট খুঁটিনাটি জিনিস — যেমন পোলোর সাইড টেপ, কলার টেপ, বুকের লোগো; শার্টের কলার, কাফ, পকেট; জিন্স-প্যান্টের রিভেট, পকেটের সেলাই — এখন একটা তালিকা ধরে খুঁজে বের করার ব্যবস্থা শুরু হলো, শুধু কাঁচা ছবিতে না, মডেলে পরা বা মানুষের শরীরের আকারে বসানো ছবিতেও। মালিক প্রতিটা প্রস্তাবিত জায়গা মেনে নিতে, নাম বদলাতে, নতুন করে যুক্ত করতে বা বাতিল করতে পারবেন — কিছুই পুরোপুরি মুছে যায় না। এখনো আসল স্বয়ংক্রিয় খোঁজার যন্ত্র চালু হয়নি, এটা আসবে পরের অংশে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: detail finder — part 1 (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.10 "Detail Finder — auto-focus on the small things that sell a premium garment": "a polo has side tapes with the brand name, a side vent, collar tape, embroidery, print under the placket … these small details are what make a garment look premium, and they must be shown … a checklist of likely detail points … the system scans the uploaded images and proposes the regions it found, labelled. The owner confirms, renames, adds or removes … Focus crops are produced from the ghost and on-model renders too, not only from the flat-lay", C7.22 item 20; `DetailRegion`'s own doc comment already named this PR, shared with PR 454 and PR 464; no migration for the table itself — one small additive column, migration 0189, `rejectedAt` — the owner's own "remove" needs a terminal state `approved` alone cannot tell apart from "not yet reviewed," and nothing here is ever a delete; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–462): grows PR 454's own `packages/photoshoot/src/detailRegions.ts` in place (the same pattern PR 452 grew `jobs.ts`, PR 459/460 grew `outputs.ts`/`createOrReuseJob`) with the Detail Finder's own, different use of the same `DetailRegion` bbox shape — on a FINISHED image (the ghost-mannequin or on-model render) rather than on a real original, so PR 454's own one-way "never on a generated image" rule deliberately does not apply to these rows; kept from ever colliding with PR 454's own `logo`/`print`/`embroidery`/`text`/`label` rows sharing the same `kind` column by namespacing every Detail Finder row's `kind` as `finder:<garmentType>:<point>` (`detailFinderKind`/`parseDetailFinderKind`, a clean round-trip, no schema change needed for the discriminator). `DETAIL_FINDER_GARMENT_TYPES`/`DETAIL_FINDER_CHECKLIST` — C7.10's own fixed checklist, verbatim (polo: side tape, side vent, collar tape, placket and buttons, cuff, chest logo; shirt: collar, cuff, button, pocket, yoke, stitch density; denim/chino: rivets, back pocket stitching, label, zip and hardware, selvedge; hoodie: drawcord tips, kangaroo pocket, rib, zip pull; panjabi: neck embroidery, button placket, side slit) — a narrow, Detail-Finder-only vocabulary, never the general category/recipe framework PR 469–470 build later for shot planning. `proposeDetailFocusRegion` (`photoshoot.generate`) is the primitive a later job runner's own automatic scanner will call (no CV provider exists yet — the same honest gap PR 454's own `detectedBy: 'manual'` already named for its own regions; nothing here ever calls out to actually find a region on a real photo) — refuses only an asset outside the store or a checklist point its garment type never listed, and deliberately never checks `isOriginal`. The owner's own four actions on C7.10's own words: `addDetailFocusRegion` (`photoshoot.write`, "add" — starts already `approved: true`, no one else to confirm the owner's own typed-in region against), `confirmDetailFocusRegion` (`photoshoot.approve`, "confirm"), `renameDetailFocusRegion` (`photoshoot.write`, "rename" — relabels within the SAME garment type only, since the garment type is a fact about the product, never the region), `removeDetailFocusRegion` (`photoshoot.write`, "remove" — sets the new `rejectedAt`, never a delete; refuses removing an already-confirmed or already-removed region; a removed region can never be confirmed or renamed back, only re-added). `listDetailFocusRegionsForProduct` (`photoshoot.read`) filters strictly to the `finder:` namespace, so a PR 454 region never leaks through. `detailFinderCoverage` (pure) reads a garment type's own checklist points as `missing`/`proposed`/`confirmed`/`rejected_only` against a product's real regions — sets up Part 2's own focus-crop generation and C7.10's "the collar tape is not readable — please take one closer photo" readability gate on a `missing` point, without doing either (this PR's own honest scope). 10 new pure tests (`detailRegions.test.ts`: the checklist, the `finder:` kind round-trip, never confused with a PR 454 kind, the coverage read including the "shared point name, different garment type" edge) and 12 new DB-backed tests (`detailRegions.db.test.ts`: propose on a real flat-lay AND a generated on-model render, an invalid checklist point, cross-store refusal, permission checks for generate/approve/write, confirm, add-starts-approved, rename within type and its own refusal, remove-is-never-a-delete and its own refusal on a confirmed or already-removed region, a removed region refusing confirm/rename, the `finder:` list never returning a PR 454 row) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–462; runs in CI. `@extas/db` 249 tests (migration-ordering test fixed to the house `-- PR <n>` header convention), `@extas/photoshoot` 166 pure tests (now 137 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3217 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here (Part 2, PR 464): the actual focus-crop image itself, and the readability gate that asks the owner for one closer photo when a checklist point stays `missing`.

## PR 464

**Detail finder — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 21)**

**বাংলায়:** মালিক যে খুঁটিনাটি জায়গাটা মেনে নিলেন, সেটা এখন গ্যালারির জন্য একটা আসল কাছ থেকে তোলা ছবি হিসেবে রেকর্ড হয় — মডেলে পরা ছবির উপর হলেও, সেই ছবির নিজের আসল মূল ছবিটা ধরেই। আর কোনো জায়গায় স্পষ্ট কিছু পাওয়া না গেলে (কিছুই প্রস্তাব করা হয়নি, বা সব প্রস্তাব বাতিল হয়ে গেছে), সিস্টেম একটা সৎ অনুরোধ দেখায় — সেই জায়গার আরেকটা কাছ থেকে তোলা ছবি দিতে। এটা কোনো ত্রুটি না, স্বাভাবিক আপলোড প্রক্রিয়ার অংশ। এর সাথে C7.10-এর কাজ শেষ হলো।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: detail finder — part 2 (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.10 "each confirmed region becomes a focused close-up image in the gallery … Focus crops are produced from the ghost and on-model renders too, not only from the flat-lay … If the system cannot see a detail clearly, it asks: 'The collar tape is not readable in these photos — please take one closer photo of the collar.' … This back-and-forth is part of the normal upload flow, not an error", C7.22 item 21; no migration — no new column needed this time, unlike Part 1's `rejectedAt`; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–463): the two pieces Part 1 left out on purpose, grown into the same `detailRegions.ts`. `recordDetailFocusCropOutput` (`photoshoot.generate`) is C7.10's own "each confirmed region becomes a focused close-up image" — refuses a region that is not one of PR 463's own Detail Finder rows, or is not yet confirmed (unapproved or removed, the same "mandatory review" standing rule applied here too); filed through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint, which only ever accepts a REAL original as `sourceAssetId` (C7.6's own global rule, enforced everywhere in this package) — when the region sits on a generated render rather than the flat-lay (C7.10's own "ghost and on-model renders too"), this walks one step past the render to ITS OWN real original (guaranteed on file, since the chokepoint already enforced it when the render itself was recorded) rather than refusing or recording against the render directly, and carries the region's own id in `tags` (`detailFocusCropRegionId` reads it back, the same shape as PR 454's own `reprojectedCandidateId`) so a reviewer can always find which exact region, and which exact base image, a crop was cut from. `detailFinderClarityMessage`/`detailFinderClarityRequests` (pure, no database) are the whole of C7.10's "the system … asks" for now: built straight from a checklist point's own name (`'collar_tape'` → "The collar tape is not readable in these photos — please take one closer photo of the collar tape."), asking again for every point that is still `missing` or `rejected_only` off `detailFinderCoverage` (PR 463) and silent on a `proposed` or `confirmed` one — recomputed fresh from the real regions on file every time, never a stored request or a resolve step, so there is nothing to go stale and no upload-handling code needed yet (C7.10's own "part of the normal upload flow, not an error"). 6 new pure tests (`detailRegions.test.ts`: the crop-output tag round-trip, the clarity message's own wording, which points get asked for and which do not) and 5 new DB-backed tests (`detailRegions.db.test.ts`: a crop traced to a real flat-lay, a crop on an on-model render traced past it to that render's own real original — never the render itself, refusing an unconfirmed or removed region, refusing an unknown region and a PR 454 region, permission check) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–463; runs in CI. `@extas/photoshoot` 172 pure tests (now 142 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3217 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here: the pixel crop itself (the job runner's own later work, same honest boundary as every unbuilt pixel step before it in this stage), the real automatic scanner (still no CV provider), and any upload UI for the owner's "take one closer photo" reply — a later PR's own scope. This closes out C7.10 and C7.22 items 20–21; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 22, the footwear/product-only studio.

## PR 467

**Download-watermark pipeline (V1 C7.22 item 24)**

**বাংলায়:** ডাউনলোডের সময় ছবিতে ওয়াটারমার্ক লাগানোর ব্যবস্থা আগেই তৈরি ছিল (অন্য একটা পুরনো অংশে) — স্টুডিওর তৈরি ছবির জন্য আলাদা কোনো কোড লাগলো না, একটা নতুন পরীক্ষা চালিয়ে এটা প্রমাণ করা হলো। দুটো আলাদা ফাঁক চোখে পড়েছে, কিন্তু এখানে আন্দাজ করে বানানো হয়নি: ভিডিওর ওয়াটারমার্ক এখনো নেই (সেটা পরের ধাপের কাজ), আর মালিকের মেনে নেওয়া ছবিটা গ্যালারিতে নিজে থেকে যুক্ত হওয়ার একটা অংশ এখনো চালু করা হয়নি (সেটা পরের একটা কাজে ঠিক হবে)।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: download-watermark pipeline — confirmation, not a rebuild (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.11 "A customer browsing the site sees NO watermark … applied automatically at the moment of download … same for video … the stored original is never watermarked", C7.22 item 24; no migration, no new production code in `@extas/photoshoot` or `@extas/media`; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–466, branched as `pr-467-studio-watermark-confirmation`): investigating item 24 before writing anything found C7.11's own mechanism already fully built — under S01 · PR 23, a different stage entirely, long before S24 existed: `packages/media/src/watermark.ts`'s SVG stamp plus `serve.ts`'s own `downloadCopy`, wired through `/api/media/[id]/download`. `downloadCopy`'s own query is generic — any `MediaAsset` with `kind: 'IMAGE'`, not archived, on an active `ProductMedia` row — with no `isAiGenerated` branch anywhere in it, so a Studio render needs zero new watermark code once it is on a product's gallery. New `packages/photoshoot/src/downloadWatermark.db.test.ts` is the proof, not an assertion in a PR description, and the first test `downloadCopy` has ever had, Studio or not: it drives a photoshoot job through this package's own real chokepoints — `recordGeneratedAsset` (PR 444), `createOrReuseJob`/`transitionJob` (PR 451/452), `recordScoredOutputs` (PR 453), `decideOutputReview` (PR 458) — to a real `APPROVED` output, confirms `downloadCopy` still refuses it (`NOT_FOUND`) while it sits off any gallery, then hands the same asset to `@extas/media`'s own unchanged `attachToProduct` (the existing, generic "put this photo on the product" admin action every ordinary upload already goes through) and asserts `downloadCopy` watermarks it — made once and cached, the toggle still reaching it, the stored rendition itself untouched — with the exact same assertions PR 23's own watermark behaviour takes for a plain uploaded photo. `@extas/media` is a devDependency of `@extas/photoshoot` for this test only (production code in neither package changed; `@extas/media` keeps its single owner, CLAUDE.md rule 10). Investigating this item also surfaced two real, separate gaps, deliberately left open rather than guessed at inside a thin confirmation PR (the Follow-ups table closed 7 Nov, CN-037; filed in `docs/after-golive-notes.md` instead): (1) `downloadCopy` is hardcoded to JPEG/`kind: 'IMAGE'` — there is no video watermark path anywhere, C7.11's own "same for video" line unbuilt; S24 only ever produces stills, so this is S25's own gap to close once C7.14 hands it a real clip, never this PR's; (2) the job's own `APPROVED -> PUBLISHED` transition and `photoshoot.publish` permission (`jobs.ts`) are defined but nothing anywhere calls them — the real, working path to `ProductMedia` today is the generic `attachToProduct` this test uses, so the dead transition is a bookkeeping gap, not a watermark one, and closing it needs a product decision (a "Publish" button on the review page? which gallery role?) this PR does not make up. `@extas/photoshoot` 190 pure tests (unchanged — this PR adds only a `.db.test.ts`) plus the new DB-backed suite (skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–466; runs in CI) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change; nothing in `@extas/media` touched. This closes out C7.22 item 24; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 25, AI 360 wiring and Cost Book rows for every photoshoot sub-job.

## PR 468

**AI 360 wiring and Cost Book rows for every photoshoot sub-job (V1 C7.22 item 25)**

**বাংলায়:** ফটোশুট স্টুডিওর কাজ এখন AI 360-তে একটা নিজস্ব এজেন্ট হিসেবে নথিবদ্ধ — সাতটা স্থায়ী এজেন্টের তালিকায় না ঢুকিয়ে আলাদা রাখা হয়েছে, যাতে কারও সংখ্যা না গুলিয়ে যায়; শুরুতে বন্ধ, কোনো খরচের সীমা না বসিয়ে, আর মালিক একবার কিছু ঠিক করলে সেটা আর বদলায় না। স্টুডিওর সাতটা ছোট কাজের (ঘোস্ট-ম্যানিকুইন, মডেলে বসানো, লোগো পুনঃস্থাপন, রেজোলিউশন বাড়ানো, ফিনিশিং, খুঁটিনাটি খোঁজা, মান যাচাই) একটা তালিকা তৈরি হলো খরচের খাতার জন্য, যদিও সেই খাতার পাতা এখনও বানানো হয়নি। প্রতিটা কাজের আসল খরচ কত হয় তা এখনও অনুমান করা হয়নি — সংখ্যা বানিয়ে না বসিয়ে, আসল হিসাব পরের একটা কাজে হবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: AI 360 wiring and Cost Book rows for every photoshoot sub-job (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.20 "The photoshoot work registers in AI 360 as a named agent — Photoshoot agent — with its sub-jobs listed separately … Every sub-job has its own row in the AI Cost Book … The Photoshoot agent has its own monthly cap in AI 360 … Every generation writes to the same `ai_usage_ledger` … Photoshoot cost is not a separate pot of money", C7.22 item 25; no migration — `AiAgent`/`AiUsageLedger` already in the full S00 schema; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–467, branched as `pr-468-ai360-wiring-cost-book`): closes the half of the long-flagged gap (`spendCap.ts`'s own PR 452 comment: "No `AiAgent` row keyed `photoshoot` exists yet") that is honestly `@extas/photoshoot`'s own to close. `ensurePhotoshootAgentRow` (grows `spendCap.ts` in place) seeds the real `AiAgent` row keyed `photoshoot` — its own identity (code `STUDIO-PHOTOSHOOT`, "Photoshoot agent", the C7.20 role text) kept in step on every call, the owner's own `enabled`/`monthlyCapMinor`/`keepOnWhenMasterOff`/`schedule` never touched once set, the same guarantee admin-ai's own `ensureAgentRows` (PR 304) already makes for the seven human-named agents — deliberately a DIFFERENT row, outside that fixed roster (`apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/agents.ts`, pinned at exactly seven by its own tests, a different lane's shared file, CLAUDE.md rule 10): Photoshoot is a pipeline, not a person. Called from `photoshootAgentCapCheck`, so the row always exists by the time anything asks about the cap — the dead-row gap `startProcessing`'s own spend-cap check has carried since PR 452 is closed; nothing about the check's own behaviour changes (still "none" with no cap set, CN-018 ships off). New `packages/photoshoot/src/costBook.ts` (pure, no database — the other half of item 25): `PHOTOSHOOT_SUB_JOBS`, C7.20's own seven named sub-jobs verbatim and in its own order (ghost mannequin, try-on, detail re-projection, upscale, finishing, detail finder, quality scoring), each pointed at the module that actually builds it today — the Cost Book's own DATA, since no AI Cost Book screen exists anywhere yet (S15 · PR 312, not built — S15 itself only 7/48 as of this PR), the same "no screen reads it yet, the first one that does gets it for free" shape PR 460's own recommendation-note system already left for its own first reader; not exported from `index.ts` yet, the same deliberate choice already made for `costLedger.ts`/`recommendation.ts`, both still without a consumer outside this package. Deliberately NOT here, with the precise reason named rather than guessed at (filed in `docs/after-golive-notes.md`; the Follow-ups table in `PROGRESS.md` closed 7 Nov, CN-037): writing a real `AiUsageLedger` row for a generation — `recordGenerationCostEntry` (`costLedger.ts`) knows the real spend in BDT minor units and which provider ran it, but `AiUsageLedger.costUsdMicros` is a NOT-NULL real USD figure (`@extas/photoshoot` has no exchange-rate reader; CN-018, never invent a number) and `.modelKey` is meant to be the provider's own literal model-version string (FASHN's `tryon-v1.6`/`tryon-max`), which lives behind `@extas/adapters`'s own boundary this package has deliberately never crossed since PR 452 — wiring the real ledger write needs one of those two gaps closed first, by whichever PR owns it. Also deliberately NOT here: a per-sub-job cost estimate (`estimateGenerationCostMinor`/`photoshootRecommendationNote`, PR 459/460, are keyed by provider + tier, not by sub-job — a genuine per-sub-job estimate needs real per-call timing/billing, a later PR's own scope); any Control room or Studio admin screen (every PR in this stage so far ships "No new admin page"; this one does too). 2 existing DB-backed tests in `jobs.db.test.ts` updated in place (the "no AiAgent row yet" cap test now also asserts PR 468's own seed fired with no invented cap; the "cap reached" test upserts rather than creates, proving the seed never clobbers a cap the owner already set) and 3 new DB-backed tests in new `spendCap.db.test.ts` (seeds once off with no cap, is idempotent and never touches an owner-set enabled/cap/keep-on/schedule, and the row's key is confirmed outside the seven fixed agents' own roster) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–467; runs in CI. 5 new pure tests in new `costBook.test.ts` (the seven sub-jobs verbatim and in order, every entry carries both languages and a real code pointer, unique keys, the lookup helpers). `@extas/photoshoot` 195 pure tests (151 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change; `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/*` (S15's own files) untouched. This closes out C7.22 item 25; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 items 26–27, the category recipe framework with the 13 recipes.

## PR 469

**Category recipe framework with the 13 recipes — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 26)**

**বাংলায়:** পোশাকের ১৩টা ধরনের (পোলো/শার্ট, প্যান্ট, লেডিস পোশাক, শিশুদের পোশাক, জুতা, ব্যাগ, ওয়ালেট, বেল্ট, ক্যাপ, সানগ্লাস, ঘড়ি, পারফিউম, মোজা/টাই) জন্য কোন পদ্ধতিতে ছবি তৈরি হবে, কতটা কোণ থেকে, কোন খুঁটিনাটি জায়গা দেখানো হবে আর কোন মডেল লাগবে — এই পুরো তালিকাটা এখন কোডে ডেটা হিসেবে লেখা হলো, ব্লুপ্রিন্টের কথায় না থেকে। মালিক নিজে এই তালিকা বদলাতে পারবেন এমন ব্যবস্থা এখনও নেই — সেটা পরের কাজে আসবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: category recipe framework — part 1, the 13 recipes as data (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.12 "Rather than a separate build per category, every product family maps to one of three engines … Each family then gets a studio recipe: which engine, how many angles, which detail points, which model library … Category recipes (defaults, all editable)", its own 13-row table, C7.22 item 26; no migration — pure, no database; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–468, branched as `pr-469-category-recipe-framework-part-1`): the general category/recipe framework `detailRegions.ts`'s own PR 463 comment already promised ("a narrow, Detail-Finder-only vocabulary, never the general category/recipe framework PR 469–470 build later for shot planning") and PR 465/466's own footwear work deliberately left unbuilt ("building it generically here would pre-empt and duplicate that PR's own work"). New `packages/photoshoot/src/recipes.ts` (pure, no database): `RECIPE_ENGINES` (C7.12's own three — `ghost_mannequin`, `on_model`, `product_only` — plus an honestly-named fourth, `real_flat`, for the two rows naming a plain, as-shot flat photo used as-is rather than any of the three generative engines "every product family maps to", so nothing is forced onto a shape it does not fit); `RECIPE_MODEL_LIBRARIES` (`men`, `ladies`, `kids`, `hand_wrist_face`); `CATEGORY_RECIPES`, C7.12's own 13 recipes verbatim and in its own order (polo/tee/shirt/panjabi, trouser/denim/chino, ladies garments, kidswear, footwear, bags, wallets, belts, caps, sunglasses, watches, perfume, socks/ties/small goods), each carrying its engines, angle count (kept as the table's own descriptive text — a plain number, a range, or a named list — never forced into one shape), detail points and model library, plus a new `detailFinderGarmentTypes` pointer naming the real `detailRegions.ts` `DetailFinderGarmentType` keys that already implement that family's own detail checklist where one has been built (`['polo','shirt','panjabi']` for the first row, `['denim_chino']` for the second, `['footwear']` for footwear — every other family empty, honestly, since nobody has wired its checklist yet) — the same "don't rebuild, point at the real thing" discipline `costBook.ts`'s own `builtIn` field (PR 468) already set, chosen deliberately over duplicating Detail Finder's finer-grained vocabulary (this table's own family groupings are coarser: "Polo / tee / shirt / panjabi" is ONE recipe row here but FOUR separate Detail Finder types there). `isCategoryRecipeKey`/`categoryRecipe` are the lookup helpers, the same shape as `costBook.ts`'s own `isPhotoshootSubJobKey`/`photoshootSubJob`. Deliberately data only, part 1 of 2: no owner override yet (C7.12's own "(defaults, all editable)" is Part 2, PR 470); no resolver mapping a real product's category to a recipe key yet (no such mapping exists in the schema today — `Product.category` is free text, not this table's own 13 keys, so building a resolver here would invent a mapping nothing asked for); no screen reads it yet, the same "first reader gets it for free" shape `costBook.ts` and `recommendation.ts` already left; not exported from `index.ts` yet, matching both. 10 new pure tests (`recipes.test.ts`: the 13 keys verbatim and in order, uniqueness, every entry bilingual with a real engine/angle-count/detail-points, every `detailFinderGarmentTypes` pointer checked against the real `DETAIL_FINDER_GARMENT_TYPES` list so the two vocabularies can never drift apart silently, footwear's own full wiring, kidswear's own no-model-by-default, the engine and model-library lists themselves, the lookup helpers and the unknown-key throw). `@extas/photoshoot` 205 pure tests (151 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here (Part 2, PR 470): the owner's own "all editable" override on these defaults. This closes out half of C7.22 item 26; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 27, the category recipe framework's own owner-editable override.

## PR 470

**Category recipe framework — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 27)**

**বাংলায়:** মালিক এখন চাইলে আগের কাজে বানানো ১৩টা পণ্যের ধরনের নিয়ম (কোন পদ্ধতি, কতটা কোণ, কোন খুঁটিনাটি জায়গা, কোন মডেল) বদলাতে পারবেন — শুরুতে কিছুই বদলানো নেই, সব আগের সাধারণ নিয়মেই চলবে, যে ধরনটা বদলাতে চান শুধু সেটাই বদলাবে, বাকিগুলো আগের মতোই থাকবে। এই বদলানোর বোতাম দেখানোর জন্য এখনও কোনো পাতা তৈরি হয়নি — সেটা পরের কোনো কাজে হবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: category recipe framework — part 2, the owner's own "(defaults, all editable)" override (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.12 "Category recipes (defaults, all editable)", C7.22 item 27; no migration — `AiAgent`/`SettingDefinition` machinery already in the schema, synced from the registry the usual way; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–469, branched as `pr-470-category-recipe-framework-part-2`): the piece Part 1 (PR 469) left out on purpose. New `@extas/settings` registry file `registry-photoshoot-recipes.ts` (registry version 293): `studio.photoshoot.recipeOverrides`, a per-store JSON setting keyed by the same 13 family keys PR 469's own `CATEGORY_RECIPES` names, each an entirely optional partial override (`engines`, `angleCount`, `detailPoints`, `modelLibrary`) — ships as `{}`, nothing overridden, every family on PR 469's own default until the owner changes one (CN-018). `@extas/settings` cannot import `@extas/photoshoot` (the dependency runs the other way — `@extas/photoshoot` already depends on `@extas/settings` for every other studio setting), so the 13 keys are named here as their own literal list (`PHOTOSHOOT_RECIPE_KEYS`) rather than imported; a new cross-check test in `@extas/photoshoot`'s own `recipes.test.ts` (which CAN import `@extas/settings`, the normal dependency direction) asserts the two lists stay identical, so they can never drift apart silently. Grows PR 469's own `recipes.ts` in place: `applyCategoryRecipeOverride` (pure) merges one family's own override onto its defaults field by field — an unset field keeps the default, and `modelLibrary: null` is itself kept apart from "not set" (checked with `!== undefined`, never `??`), since turning a family's model off on purpose is a real, different choice from never having said anything; `effectiveCategoryRecipe` (async) is the one real reader — PR 469's own default, with whatever the owner has actually set in `studio.photoshoot.recipeOverrides` applied on top, through the same `setting(deps, storeId, key)` helper (`context.ts`) every other studio setting already reads through. Deliberately NOT here: any admin screen for the owner to actually type an override into (no Studio admin page exists yet, the same "No new admin page" every PR in this stage has shipped); any real caller of `effectiveCategoryRecipe` from inside a job (no code yet maps a real product's own category to one of these 13 recipe keys — Part 1's own honest gap, still open). 7 new pure tests grown into `recipes.test.ts` (the cross-check against `@extas/settings`'s own key list; the merge keeping every untouched field; the `modelLibrary: null` real-choice case; overriding engines and detail points together; `effectiveCategoryRecipe` reading a fake `SettingsReader` — the plain default with nothing overridden, and one family's own override never leaking onto another) and 7 new pure tests in new `packages/settings/test/registry-photoshoot-recipes.test.ts` (registered at v293, store-scoped, bilingual, its own `{}` default; exactly 13 keys; a real family's partial override accepted, an unknown family and an unknown field refused; an empty or over-long engines list refused). `@extas/photoshoot` 212 pure tests (151 DB-only skipped) and `@extas/settings` 4834 tests stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3223 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. This closes out C7.22 items 26–27 and the whole category recipe framework; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 items 28–29, the worn-accessory engine for caps, sunglasses, watches and carried bags.

## PR 471

**Worn-accessory engine (caps, sunglasses, watches, carried bags) — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 28)**

**বাংলায়:** ক্যাপ, সানগ্লাস, ঘড়ি আর কাঁধের ব্যাগ — এই চারটা পণ্যের জন্য এখন দুই ধরনের ছবির ব্যবস্থা ঠিক হলো: একটা পরা অবস্থায় (মাথায়, মুখে, হাতে, কাঁধে) আর একটা শুধু জিনিসটার নিজের ছবি (রাখা বা ভাঁজ করা)। প্রতিটা দুই ছবিই সত্যিকারের ছবি থেকে আসতে হবে, একটা থেকে আরেকটা বানানো হয় না। প্রতিটা পণ্যের নিজের খুঁটিনাটি জায়গা (ক্যাপের লোগো, সানগ্লাসের কাঁটা, ঘড়ির ডায়াল, ব্যাগের হাতল ইত্যাদি) আগের খুঁটিনাটি-খোঁজার তালিকায় যুক্ত হলো। ঘড়ি, সানগ্লাস আর ব্যাগের আসল লোগো/লেখা সত্যিকারের ছবি থেকেই বসানো বাধ্যতামূলক — এই নিয়মটা এখন তথ্য হিসেবে লেখা হলো; আসল বাধা পরের কাজে চালু হবে।

## PR 472

**Worn-accessory engine — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 29)**

**বাংলায়:** ক্যাপ, সানগ্লাস, ঘড়ি আর ব্যাগের তৈরি করা ছবি এখন আসলেই রেকর্ড হয়। ঘড়ি, সানগ্লাস আর ব্যাগের জন্য আগে সেই ছবির সত্যিকারের রেফারেন্স ছবিতে লোগো/লেখার জায়গা মালিকের অনুমোদন করা থাকতে হবে — না থাকলে ছবি তৈরি হবে না; ক্যাপের জন্য এই বাধা নেই। কোনো দিকের (পরা বা রাখা) সত্যিকারের ছবি না থাকলে মালিককে স্পষ্ট করে বলা হয় কোন দিকের আরেকটা ছবি লাগবে। এর সাথে ক্যাপ-সানগ্লাস-ঘড়ি-ব্যাগের পুরো ব্যবস্থাটা শেষ হলো।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: worn-accessory engine — part 2, recording the output and the mandatory detail-reprojection gate (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.12 "a multi-angle set … on the standard background, with consistent shadow and scale", "the system says plainly when it does not [have enough reference] and asks for the missing angle rather than inventing it", and "Detail re-projection is mandatory for these families — the real logo and text are composited back from the owner's photograph, never left to the model", C7.22 item 29; no migration; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–471, branched as `pr-472-worn-accessory-engine-part-2`): the three pieces Part 1 left out on purpose, grown into the same `wornAccessoryStudio.ts`. `recordWornAccessoryOutput` (`photoshoot.generate`) is C7.12's own finished render for one family and view — refuses unless the named `sourceAssetId` is itself a real, non-archived reference photo tagged with THIS exact view's own role (`NO_WORN_ACCESSORY_REFERENCE`, a new `PhotoshootErrorCode`, the same "never invent" hard rule PR 466 enforces for every footwear angle), and, for `sunglasses`/`watches`/`bags` (Part 1's own `wornAccessoryRequiresDetailReprojection`), ALSO refuses unless an approved `DetailRegion` (PR 454) already exists on that exact source reference photo (`DETAIL_REPROJECTION_REQUIRED`, a second new error code) — C7.12's own "mandatory for these families" sentence actually enforced as a gate, never left as a comment; caps pass through with no such gate, since the blueprint names only the other three. Filed through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint, tagged `WORN_ACCESSORY_STUDIO_TAG` plus the family's own key (so a watch's `worn` output is never confused with a bag's). `findExistingWornAccessoryOutput` (`photoshoot.read`) is the reuse lookup a later job orchestrator checks before paying twice, the same shape as `findExistingFootwearStudioOutput` (PR 466), scoped to the family's own tag so a cap's output never satisfies a bag's reuse check. `wornAccessoryMissingViewMessage`/`wornAccessoryMissingViewRequests` (pure, no database) are C7.12's own "the system … says plainly … and asks" for the worn-accessory engine, built straight from the family and view names, recomputed fresh every time off Part 1's `missingWornAccessoryViews` — the same "part of the normal upload flow, not an error" shape `footwearMissingAngleMessage`/`footwearMissingAngleRequests` (PR 466) already set, one level up from Detail Finder's own per-point clarity message (PR 464). 5 new pure tests grown into `wornAccessoryStudio.test.ts` (the message's own wording naming the family and the view in plain words, which views get asked for and which do not, generated/archived references never counting, every family's own plain label) and 7 new DB-backed tests in new `wornAccessoryStudio.db.test.ts` (a cap's worn output recorded with no mandatory gate at all; every "never invent" refusal shape — missing/foreign-role/archived/generated source; watches/sunglasses/bags each refused with no approved detail region on file, then let through once one is approved on that exact reference photo; an unapproved-but-present region still refuses a mandatory family; permission check; the reuse lookup scoped to its own family, never matching an untagged row) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–471; runs in CI. `@extas/photoshoot` 234 pure tests (158 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3224 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. This closes out C7.22 items 28–29 and the whole worn-accessory engine; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 30, reflective and transparent product handling (perfume, watch glass, sunglass lenses).
