## PR 473

**Reflective and transparent product handling (V1 C7.22 item 30)**

**বাংলায়:** পারফিউমের বোতল, ঘড়ির কাঁচ আর সানগ্লাসের লেন্স — এই তিনটা জিনিস কখনো AI দিয়ে বানানো হয় না, কারণ কাঁচ, প্রতিফলন আর স্বচ্ছতা AI ভুল বানায়। বদলে মালিকের তোলা আসল ফোন-ছবিটাই রাখা হয় — ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড পরিষ্কার করে, ছায়া আর একটা নিয়ন্ত্রিত প্রতিফলন নতুন করে বসিয়ে, রং ঠিক করে, আর নির্দিষ্ট মাপে কেটে একটাই পরিষ্কার স্টুডিও ছবি তৈরি হয়। আসল ছবি না থাকলে মালিককে স্পষ্ট করে বলা হয় একটা ছবি দিতে — কিছুই বানিয়ে বলা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: reflective and transparent product handling (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.12 "Reflective and transparent goods — honest handling. Perfume bottles, watch glass and sunglass lenses are the weakest area for generative models … These are not generated. Instead the pipeline keeps the owner's real photo, replaces and cleans the background, rebuilds the shadow and a controlled reflection, corrects colour, and crops to standard … Where a real angle is missing, the system asks for it", C7.22 item 30; no migration — `MediaAsset.role` is already a free string; same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–472, branched as `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling`): a genuinely different engine from every other S24 module built so far, checked against C7.12 before writing anything — ghost mannequin, footwear and the worn-accessory engine all produce a NEW staged photograph; here "these are not generated," so the only output is the owner's own real photo with its background, shadow, reflection and colour cleaned up and its crop standardised. New `packages/photoshoot/src/reflectiveTransparentStudio.ts`: `REFLECTIVE_TRANSPARENT_FAMILIES` — C7.12's own three named subjects verbatim (`perfume`, `watch_glass`, `sunglass_lens`), deliberately NOT the same keys as `recipes.ts`'s or `wornAccessoryStudio.ts`'s own whole-product `watches`/`sunglasses` families, since this engine owns only the glass/transparency surface each gets wrong, never the product as a whole. `roles.ts` gains the one genuinely new role this honest pipeline needs, `reflective_reference` (a real, unedited phone photo of the subject) — the same reasoning that justified PR 471's own `worn_reference` rather than reusing an existing role. `planReflectiveTransparentOutput`/`hasReflectiveReference` are C7.12's own "never invent" gate: singular, never multi-angle, by design — C7.12's own summarising sentence says "a clean studio look from A PHONE PHOTO" (singular), so this engine takes exactly one real reference per product, unlike footwear's six angles or the worn-accessory engine's two views. `recordReflectiveTransparentOutput` (`photoshoot.generate`) refuses unless the named `sourceAssetId` is itself a real, non-archived `reflective_reference` photo (`NO_REFLECTIVE_REFERENCE`, a new `PhotoshootErrorCode`, the same "never invent" hard rule PR 466/472 enforce for footwear's angles and the worn-accessory engine's views), filed through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint, tagged `REFLECTIVE_TRANSPARENT_STUDIO_TAG`, the family's own key, and every one of `REFLECTIVE_TRANSPARENT_PIPELINE_STAGES` (C7.12's own pipeline sentence, verbatim and in order: `background_replace`, `shadow_rebuild`, `reflection_control`, `colour_correct`, `crop_to_standard`) — recorded together on ONE finished output, deliberately never split into separate owner-reviewed steps the way C7.8's finishing pass (PR 455/456) is, since C7.12 describes this as one continuous honest process on one real photo, never a named, PR-split sequence. `findExistingReflectiveTransparentOutput` (`photoshoot.read`) is the reuse lookup, the same shape as `findExistingFootwearStudioOutput`/`findExistingWornAccessoryOutput`, scoped to the family's own tag. `reflectiveTransparentMissingReferenceMessage`/`reflectiveTransparentMissingReferenceRequests` (pure, no database) are C7.12's own "the system … asks for it," one real photo rather than one of several named angles/views — zero or one request, kept plural for the same "iterate every engine's own missing-input list the same way" reason the other engines return an array. `completedReflectiveTransparentStages` reads the stage tags back, the same round-trip shape `completedFinishingSteps` (PR 455/456) already set. Deliberately NOT here, with the reason named: a sub-job row in the AI Cost Book (PR 468's own `PHOTOSHOOT_SUB_JOBS` is C7.20's own fixed list of seven, and this engine is not one of them); any change to `recipes.ts`'s own `perfume`/`watches`/`sunglasses` rows (unrelated — those already name `product_only` as a real engine, and this module is the honest, never-generated version of exactly that for the one surface generation gets wrong); the "Detail fidelity on branded goods" mandatory re-projection gate (PR 472's own, different paragraph, already enforced there for watches/sunglasses/bags as whole products). 15 new pure tests (`reflectiveTransparentStudio.test.ts`: the family list verbatim and with no duplicates, `isReflectiveTransparentFamily` refusing the unrelated whole-product keys, the "never invent" plan's readiness/refusal shapes — real/generated/archived/wrong-role — the missing-reference message and request list, and the pipeline-stage list and its tag round-trip) and one small addition to `roles.test.ts` (the new role present in `ASSET_ROLES`). 7 new DB-backed tests in new `reflectiveTransparentStudio.db.test.ts` (a perfume output recorded and tagged with every pipeline stage; every refusal shape — missing/foreign-role/archived/generated source; the real reference photo itself left untouched; a reader without `photoshoot.generate` refused; the reuse lookup scoped to its own family, never matching an untagged row or a different family's own output on the same real photo) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–472; runs in CI. `@extas/photoshoot` 249 pure tests (163 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3225 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. This closes out C7.22 item 30; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 31, ladies/kids and part-model libraries with styling guidelines.

## PR 474

**Ladies, kids and part-model libraries with styling guidelines (V1 C7.22 item 31)**

**বাংলায়:** কোন মডেল কোন লাইব্রেরিতে (পুরুষ/মহিলা/শিশু) পড়বে, আর প্রতিটা মডেলকে কীভাবে সাজানো-পোজ করানো হবে — এই দুটোই মালিক নিজে ঠিক করবেন একবার করে, কখনো আন্দাজ করে বসানো হবে না। হাত/কব্জি/মুখের ছোট মডেল (ঘড়ি, সানগ্লাস, ব্যাগের জন্য) আপনা-আপনি তার নিজের লাইব্রেরিতে পড়ে, আলাদা করে বলার দরকার নেই। শিশু-মডেল বন্ধই থাকবে যতক্ষণ না মালিক একসাথে দুটো জিনিস করেন — একটা আলাদা সুইচ চালু করা, আর শিশুদের পোশাকের রেসিপিতে শিশু-লাইব্রেরি বেছে নেওয়া।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: ladies/kids and part-model libraries with styling guidelines (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.12 "Model libraries": "Ladies (4–5 profiles) — each profile carries a styling guideline the owner sets (how the model is dressed and posed) so the result matches what sells in this market. His call, set once per profile", "Kids — added, but the default for kidswear is ghost mannequin or flat-lay, not a child model … several providers restrict generating realistic images of children, results are less reliable, and ghost shots of kidswear look clean and are cheaper. A kids model profile can be enabled later if the owner wants it", "Hand / wrist / face part-models … treated exactly like a model profile", C7.22 item 31; no migration — deliberately kept off `StudioModel` (the Prisma schema has one owner after Phase 0, CLAUDE.md rule "own the file, not the feature"; `gender`/`ageGroup` on `models.ts`'s own `ModelRow` are free text, never a fixed vocabulary, so guessing a model's library from them would be an invented classification, not a real one); same worktree/branch lineage as PR 451–473, branched as `pr-474-ladies-kids-part-model-libraries`): the three library-level pieces PR 445's own model library and PR 469/470's own `recipes.ts` (`RECIPE_MODEL_LIBRARIES`: `men`/`ladies`/`kids`/`hand_wrist_face`) left open. New `@extas/settings` registry file `registry-photoshoot-model-library.ts` (registry version 294): `studio.photoshoot.modelLibraryAssignments` — which library (`men`/`ladies`/`kids`) a full-body `StudioModel` belongs to, keyed by its real id; `studio.photoshoot.modelStylingGuideline` — the owner's own free-text styling note per model id (C7.12's "His call, set once per profile"); both ship `null`, never `{}` (the owner's own data, PR 509 — a real `StudioModel.id` is already owner data, `owner-data.ts`'s `item('StudioModel', 'people')` — so both are flagged `isOwnerData: true` and have no default, the same shape `registry-category.ts`'s own `category.faqOwn` already uses); `studio.photoshoot.kidsModelEnabled` — a plain feature switch, off by default (CN-018), kept apart from PR 470's own generic `recipeOverrides` since C7.12 frames turning on a child model as its own separate, affirmative decision (provider restrictions, reliability, cost), never folded into the general per-family override. New `packages/photoshoot/src/modelLibraries.ts`: `ASSIGNABLE_MODEL_LIBRARIES` (`men`/`ladies`/`kids` only — `hand_wrist_face` is never an owner choice per model, since `models.ts`'s own `kind: 'part'` already names it structurally, the moment a part-model row exists); `modelLibraryOf` (pure) and `effectiveModelLibrary` (reads the setting) answer which library a model belongs to — a part model is always `hand_wrist_face` regardless of any assignment on file; a full-body model is whatever the owner explicitly assigned, or `null` when unassigned, never guessed from `gender`/`ageGroup`; `modelStylingGuidelines`/`stylingGuidelineFor` read one model's own note back, `null` when the owner has written none; `kidsModelAllowed` is the dedicated TWO-gate check (mirroring PR 472's own dual-gate shape for detail re-projection) an on-model kidswear job must pass before it may ever run — `kidsModelEnabled` AND the recipe's own `modelLibrary === 'kids'` (set through PR 470's own override) both true; either one false keeps kidswear on its C7.12 default (ghost mannequin / flat-lay, no model). 14 new pure tests (`modelLibraries.test.ts`: a part model always resolving to `hand_wrist_face` even with a contradicting assignment on file; an assigned full-body model resolving to its own library; an unassigned one resolving to `null`, never a guess; a corrupt/foreign value in the map never thrown, only treated as unassigned; the styling-guideline round-trip leaving every other model's own note untouched; all four combinations of the kids-model dual gate) and 7 new pure tests in new `packages/settings/test/registry-photoshoot-model-library.test.ts` (registered at v294, store-scoped, bilingual, every default valid; the owner-data default is `null`, never `{}`; the kids switch is off and never owner data; the assignable-library list is exactly men/ladies/kids; both maps refuse an unknown library, a non-uuid key, or an empty styling note). `@extas/photoshoot` 263 pure tests (163 DB-only skipped) and `@extas/settings` 4855 tests stay green; typecheck (settings package needs an 8 GB-equivalent `--max-old-space-size=6144` heap — the same generous CI heap `ci.yml` already sets for this package, not a new requirement), lint and the hardcode guard (0/3229 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change — the generic admin Settings screen already edits any JSON setting, the same way it already does for `recipeOverrides`. Deliberately NOT here: a writer function with its own `photoshoot.write` check (the generic settings-write path already covers this, the same as every other photoshoot setting including PR 470's own `recipeOverrides`); any caller that actually matches a product's recipe against a real model (no job orchestrator reads `recipes.ts`'s `modelLibrary` yet — PR 469's own honest gap, still open); exporting `modelLibraries.ts` from `index.ts` (no screen or job reads it yet, the same "not exported yet" choice PR 469/470 made for `recipes.ts`). This closes out C7.22 item 31; the next unbuilt S24 item is C7.22 item 32, combo and gift-set composition studio.

## PR 475

**বাংলায়:** কম্বো বা গিফট সেটের একাধিক জিনিসের আগে-তোলা ছবি একসাথে সাজিয়ে একটা পূর্ণ স্টুডিও ছবি তৈরি করার ব্যবস্থা — দোকানের পাতার সাধারণ কোলাজ ছবি (PR 575) থেকে আলাদা, কারণ এখানে ছবিটা সাজিয়ে তোলা হয়। প্রতিটা জিনিসের নিজের একটা বাস্তব, যুক্ত করা ছবি আগে থেকেই থাকতে হবে — না থাকলে, বা সেটা মুছে ফেলা হয়ে থাকলে, কাজটা আটকে যাবে আর কোনটা বাদ পড়েছে তা বলে দেবে। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ আর ডিফল্ট সাজসজ্জা দিয়ে।

## PR 476

**Scene library (V1 C7.22 item 33)**

**বাংলায়:** স্টুডিওর জন্য অনুমোদিত ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ডের একটা ছোট লাইব্রেরি — স্টুডিও গ্রে, স্ট্রিট, উৎসব, শীত — আর পরে মালিকের অনুমোদন করা যেকোনো উপলক্ষের সিন। একবার অনুমোদন হয়ে গেলে একই পোশাকের সেট নতুন শুটিং না করেই সেই সিনে আবার বসানো যায়। একটা সিন তখনই লাইব্রেরিতে রাখা হয় যখন মালিক সত্যিকারের একটা ডেমো ছবি দেখে অনুমোদন দিয়েছেন — কিছুই বানিয়ে বসানো হয় না। সিনটা একাধিক দোকানে ভাগ করে রাখা যায়, বা একটা দোকানে আলাদা করেও রাখা যায়। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ আর ডিফল্ট ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড দিয়ে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: scene library (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.13 "Scene library" — verbatim: "Beyond the plain studio background, a small set of approved backgrounds — studio grey, street, festive, winter — chosen per campaign. One garment set can then be re-rendered into a seasonal scene without a new shoot," plus C7.13's own occasion-scene sentence "Approved scenes are saved to the scene library and reused, so the catalogue stays consistent within a season"; C7.22 item 33; AI-2 lane, same worktree, branch `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling` kept as is per CN-044's standing lane instruction — no rename, built straight on PR 475's own tip, stacking PR 451–476): the shared catalogue two other named C7.22 items will draw from (the occasion-scene suggester, item 37/PR 480, still unbuilt, will call this PR's own write side once the owner approves a suggested scene's demo; every S24 render engine will call its read side once a job orchestrator applies a saved scene — neither exists yet, the same honest "no caller yet" gap PR 474/475 left for their own switches). No migration (the Prisma schema is a single-owner shared file) — an approved scene is recorded as an ordinary `MediaAsset` row through PR 444's own `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint, read back off its tags, never a new table; A4.3's "the Studio … scene libraries, which a store may use or keep private" is already a real column on `MediaAsset` (`sharedWithAllStores`, migrated for PR 445's own model library and already read by `models.ts`'s own `listModels`) — this is simply the first module to read/write that column for a `MediaAsset`-backed library rather than a `StudioModel` one. New `packages/photoshoot/src/sceneLibrary.ts`: `SCENE_LIBRARY_PRESETS` (C7.13's own four named backgrounds, verbatim: `studio_grey`/`street`/`festive`/`winter`) and `isSceneLibraryKey` (accepts those four plus a well-formed custom slug, for the occasion suggester's own future scene keys — e.g. `eid_evening` — without guessing its naming scheme); `planSceneLibraryEntry`/`missingSceneLibraryEntries`/`sceneLibraryMissingDemoMessage`/`sceneLibraryMissingDemoRequests` — C7.6's "never invent" rule generalised once more: a scene is only "ready" once a real, approved demo is already on file, pure and fed by the caller's own fact, the same discipline `planComboGiftSetComposition`/`planReflectiveTransparentOutput` already follow; `recordSceneLibraryEntry` (`photoshoot.generate`) refuses (`NO_SCENE_REFERENCE`, a new `PhotoshootErrorCode`) unless the named `sourceAssetId` is itself a real, non-archived, original photo in this store — `recordGeneratedAsset`'s own chokepoint does not by itself check `archivedAt` (the same gap `reflectiveTransparentStudio.ts`/`comboGiftSetStudio.ts` already close themselves), filed through that chokepoint, tagged `SCENE_LIBRARY_TAG` and the scene's own `sceneLibrarySceneTag`, with `sharedWithAllStores` then set on the new row exactly as asked (off by default — a newly approved scene starts private); `findLatestSceneLibraryEntry`/`listSceneLibrary` (`photoshoot.read`) are the reuse/catalogue reads, scoped like `models.ts`'s own `listModels` (the store's own entries plus every entry shared with all stores), `listSceneLibrary` collapsing to one (the newest) entry per scene key so "the catalogue stays consistent within a season." `roles.ts` gains one new role, `scene_library_demo` — unlike PR 475's own `combo_gift_set_composition`, this one IS meant to be reused as a reference for a later, different garment set (C7.13's own "re-rendered into a seasonal scene without a new shoot"), so `REFERENCE_ROLES` does not exclude it (one widened assertion in `roles.test.ts`, the length delta unchanged at `ASSET_ROLES.length - 2`). No new admin page; no admin-guide change — the generic admin Settings screen already edits any JSON setting. Deliberately NOT here: the occasion-scene suggester itself (item 37, PR 480, still unbuilt) and wiring any render engine to actually apply a saved scene to a new garment set (no job orchestrator calls this module yet, the same honest gap PR 474/475 left for their own switches); a new AI Cost Book sub-job row (C7.20's own fixed list of seven is not widened, the same reasoning PR 473/475's own headers already give). ## PR 477

**Set product type and two-garment try-on — part 1 (V1 C7.22 item 34)**

**বাংলায়:** ট্র্যাকসুট বা টপ-বটম সেটের জন্য "Set" নামের নতুন পণ্যের ধরন — আসলে নতুন কিছু বানানো হয়নি, কম্বো ব্যবস্থায় আগে থেকেই থাকা দুই-টুকরার TOP_BOTTOM কম্বোকেই এখন সেট হিসেবে ধরা হচ্ছে, যার টপ আর বটম দুটোই আলাদা SKU। একই মডেলের ছবিতে দুইবার বসিয়ে (আগে টপ, পরে বটম) পুরো সেট পরা একটাই ছবি তৈরির পরিকল্পনা — সামনে, তিন-চতুর্থাংশ, পিছনে আর হাঁটার ছবি — কিন্তু দুটো টুকরার আসল ছবি একসাথে না থাকলে কিছুই বানিয়ে বসানো হবে না, আর কোন অংশ বাকি আছে তা আলাদা করে বলে দেয়। সেটের নিজের ডিটেইল তালিকা (হুড-ড্রকর্ড, কাফ-রিব, জিপ-পুলার, সাইড স্ট্রাইপ, পকেট, অ্যাংকেল রিব, ওয়েস্টব্যান্ড ড্রকর্ড, ভিতরের ফ্লিস টেক্সচার) আগের Detail Finder ব্যবস্থাতেই যুক্ত হলো। এখনও কোনো ছবি রেকর্ড হয় না — সেটা পরের ধাপে (পার্ট ২)।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: set product type and two-garment try-on, part 1 (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.13 "Top-bottom sets and tracksuits — the owner's core winter business … New product type: Set — a parent with a top component and a bottom component, each its own SKU, joined by a colourway link so the set's colour stays matched … The try-on engine runs two passes on the same model image — upper body, then lower body — producing one photograph of the model wearing the whole set. Angles: front, three-quarter, back, plus a motion/walking frame … Detail points for this family: hood and drawcord, cuff and hem rib, zip pull and puller branding, side stripe or tape, pocket, ankle rib, waistband drawcord, and fleece inside texture (a real macro) … Links to the existing combo engine: a tracksuit sold as a set is one sellable unit", C7.22 item 34; no migration — investigated before writing anything (the same discipline PR 467/469 already followed): "New product type: Set" is NOT a gap — `packages/db`'s own schema already has it, `Combo` with `type: TOP_BOTTOM` (`packages/combos`'s own `FIXED_COMBO_TYPES`/`photo-layout.ts` already read this exact enum value), two `ComboItem` rows each its own real `productId` (its own SKU), position-ordered (0 = top, 1 = bottom), with the "colourway link" already real as each item's own `allowedColourIds` (PR 89/95) — C7.13's own next sentence confirms it is meant this way ("Links to the existing combo engine"), so inventing a second, parallel product type on `Product` itself (a shared, single-owner schema file, CLAUDE.md rule: shared files have one owner) would duplicate what `TOP_BOTTOM` already is; AI-2 lane, same worktree, branch `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling` kept as is per CN-044's standing lane instruction — no rename, built straight on PR 476's own tip, stacking PR 451–477): New `packages/photoshoot/src/setTryOnStudio.ts`: `SET_TRY_ON_COMPONENTS` (`top`/`bottom`, C7.13's own two SKUs) and `SET_TRY_ON_ANGLES` (`front`/`three_quarter`/`back`/`motion_walking`, C7.13's own list verbatim and in order); `isSetTryOnCombo`/`setTryOnComponentProductIds` read a `TOP_BOTTOM` combo's own two items as "the set" — pure, fed by the caller's own facts, never a database query this module runs itself, refusing (returning `null`/`false`, never inventing) a combo of the wrong type, the wrong item count, or an item slot with no real product yet; `planSetTryOnAngles` (pure) generalises `planGhostMannequinViews`'s own single-garment "never invent" shape (PR 446) to the set's own two garments at once — `front`/`three_quarter`/`motion_walking` each need a real flat-lay (`primary_garment` or `front_reference`) on BOTH components, `back` needs a real, non-archived `back_reference` on BOTH (`roles.ts`'s own `hasBackReference`, C7.6's hard rule applied to each half of the set in turn); every reason a component is missing is named separately (`NO_TOP_REFERENCE`/`NO_BOTTOM_REFERENCE`/`NO_TOP_BACK_REFERENCE`/`NO_BOTTOM_BACK_REFERENCE`), never only the first, since C7.13's own "the model must be wearing the complete set in one image" makes a half answer as dishonest as none; `missingSetTryOnAngles` reads the plan down to just the missing angles. Deliberately no new `AssetRole`: the top and the bottom are each an ordinary garment already covered by the existing `primary_garment`/`front_reference`/`back_reference` roles (C7.12's own `polo_tee_shirt_panjabi`/`trouser_denim_chino` recipe rows already name exactly this vocabulary) — a set is two already-covered garments worn together, not a new photographic subject the way a worn accessory (PR 471) or a reflective surface (PR 473) is, so `roles.ts`/`roles.test.ts` are untouched this PR. The set's own detail checklist (hood and drawcord, cuff and hem rib, zip pull and puller branding, side stripe or tape, pocket, ankle rib, waistband drawcord, fleece inside texture) is filed into Detail Finder's existing, generic machinery instead of rebuilt: `detailRegions.ts`'s `DETAIL_FINDER_GARMENT_TYPES` gains `top_bottom_set` (singular-style, named `top_bottom_set` rather than the bare `set` since `set`/`combo` already names a broader commerce concept elsewhere — `ComboType`, `comboGiftSetStudio.ts`'s own `combo`/`gift_set` kinds — and this checklist is scoped to exactly the two-garment TOP_BOTTOM family, never a 3-piece gift set or a colour pair) and `DETAIL_FINDER_CHECKLIST.top_bottom_set` the eight points verbatim; one pre-existing exact-match test (`detailRegions.test.ts`'s own `DETAIL_FINDER_GARMENT_TYPES` pin) widened, the same "narrow/widen an existing assertion when a vocabulary legitimately grows" pattern PR 465/471 already used. 18 new pure tests (`setTryOnStudio.test.ts`: the component/angle lists verbatim with no duplicates; `isSetTryOnCombo`/`setTryOnComponentProductIds` recognising a real `TOP_BOTTOM` combo and refusing the wrong type, item count or a missing product; every angle's own readiness needing both components; each missing component named separately, never only the first; the back angle's own "never invent" hard rule across both halves; a generated or archived reference never counting on either side) and 3 new pure tests in `detailRegions.test.ts` (the set's own checklist verbatim, kept separate from every other garment type's, the `finder:top_bottom_set:` kind round-trip) — all database-free, no `.db.test.ts` needed for this PR's own new code (no recorder yet). `@extas/photoshoot` 316 pure tests (178 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck, lint and the hardcode guard (0/3238 files) clean on every touched file; `admin-guide-check` clean. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here (Part 2, PR 478): recording the finished set-try-on image itself through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint, and C7.13's own "the system says plainly … and asks" for the missing component or angle. Register, README and `docs/stages/bn.json` updated in the same commit; `pnpm docs:stages` / `precommit-docs.sh` clean. Per CN-044/CLAUDE.md's standing instruction, this PR is pushed and its pull request updated but NOT merged by this session — stacked on PR 451–476, held for the FIX lane. **Next:** C7.22 item 35 — the set try-on engine's own recorder and the "ask for the missing component/angle" message (Part 2, register PR 478) — onward through S24 in order, same worktree/branch lineage (branching from PR 477's own tip).

## PR 478

**Set product type and two-garment try-on — part 2 (V1 C7.22 item 35)**

**বাংলায়:** সেট টুকরা পরা মডেলের ছবি এখন আসলেই রেকর্ড হয় — টপ বা বটমের (বা দুটোরই) আসল, এখনো-আছে, ঠিক কোণের ছবি না থাকলে কিছুই বানিয়ে বসানো হয় না, বরং ঠিক কোনটা বাদ পড়েছে তা নাম ধরে বলে দেয়। মালিককে প্লেইন ভাষায় বলা হয় কোন টুকরা বা কোণের ছবি এখনো লাগবে। এটা দিয়ে সেট ট্রাই-অন ইঞ্জিনের নিজের কাজ শেষ হলো; একসাথে মেয়ে-ছেলে মডেলের ছবি আর উপলক্ষের সিন পরের ধাপে।

**Details**

## PR 479

**Unisex / couple composition (V1 C7.22 item 36)**

**বাংলায়:** একই ইউনিসেক্স সেট পরা পুরুষ মডেল আর মহিলা মডেলের আলাদাভাবে তোলা দুটো ছবি একসাথে করে একটা দৃশ্য বানানোর ব্যবস্থা — একসাথে একটা ছবি বানানোর চেয়ে দুটো আলাদা ছবি জোড়া লাগানো বেশি নির্ভরযোগ্য, তাই এটাই করা হয়েছে। দুটো ছবিই আগে থেকে তৈরি আর বাস্তব থাকতে হবে, নাহলে কোনটা বাদ পড়েছে তা নাম ধরে বলে দিয়ে কাজ আটকে যাবে — কিছুই বানিয়ে বসানো হয় না। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ দিয়ে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: unisex/couple composition (S24 reopened, CN-039; filed into the register in this same commit per CLAUDE.md's "register first" rule — Blueprint C7.13 "Unisex / couple shots" — verbatim: "Some sets are unisex, and one frame showing a male and a female model both wearing the set says it instantly. Built as: generate each model separately on their own profile, then compose them into one scene with matched lighting, scale, ground plane and shadow. Composing two separately-generated people is far more reliable than asking a model to generate two people at once, and each person's garment stays accurate," C7.22 item 36; AI-2 lane, same worktree, branch `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling` kept as is per CN-044's standing lane instruction — no rename, built straight on PR 478's own tip, stacking PR 451–479): the blueprint's own method IS the scope — this module never generates a model wearing anything itself, it only composes TWO renders a single-model engine already produced, the same way `comboGiftSetStudio.ts` composes several already-produced PRODUCT photos rather than photographing a combo itself. The real design problem, investigated before writing anything (the same discipline PR 467/477 already followed): PR 444's own `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint only ever accepts a `sourceAssetId` that is itself a real ORIGINAL ("a generated image must trace back to a real one, never to another AI image"), yet C7.13's own method feeds this engine two ALREADY-GENERATED renders, neither an original. `finishing.ts`'s own `recordFinishingStepOutput` (PR 454) already solved exactly this shape for its own single-input case — it never passes a generated candidate's own id to `recordGeneratedAsset`, it passes `candidate.sourceAssetId`, the real original that row already traces back to; this module does the same, transitively, off the lead (male) member's own render. No migration — `MediaAsset.role` is already a free string, the same reason PR 465/471/473/475's own new roles needed none. New `packages/photoshoot/src/coupleCompositionStudio.ts`: `COUPLE_COMPOSITION_MEMBERS` (`male`/`female`, C7.13's own two named models, data only) and `COUPLE_COMPOSITION_MATCH_DIMENSIONS` (`lighting`/`scale`/`ground_plane`/`shadow`, C7.13's own compositing checklist verbatim, kept as a plain fixed fact of the photograph like `SET_TRY_ON_ANGLES`, never enforced here — no provider call exists yet); `planCoupleComposition`/`missingCoupleCompositionMembers`/`coupleCompositionMissingMemberMessage`/`coupleCompositionMissingMemberRequests` — C7.6's "never invent" rule generalised once more: a member is only "ready" once a real, already-generated render of it already exists, pure and fed by the caller's own fact (`hasRender`), the same "stays pure, never queries the database itself" discipline every other engine's own `plan*` function already follows; `recordCoupleCompositionOutput` (`photoshoot.generate`) refuses (`NO_COUPLE_MEMBER_REFERENCE`, a new `PhotoshootErrorCode`, naming every bad member — `male`, `female`, or both) unless BOTH named renders are real, non-archived, already-generated photos in this store, each itself tracing back to a real original — filed through PR 444's `recordGeneratedAsset` chokepoint against the real original the MALE member's own render traces back to (the lead member, the same single-source limit `comboGiftSetStudio.ts`/`setTryOnStudio.ts` already document), under a new `couple_composition` role, tagged `COUPLE_COMPOSITION_STUDIO_TAG` and both members' own `coupleCompositionMemberTag` (round-tripped by `coupleCompositionMembersFromTags`, the same shape `comboGiftSetPieceTag`/`setTryOnComponentTag` already set); `findExistingCoupleCompositionOutput` (`photoshoot.read`) is the reuse lookup, scoped to the exact member pair. Deliberately NOT verifying the two members show the exact same garment/set: `MediaAsset` carries no link back to which product or model a render came from — that fact lives only in the caller's own job record (the same "pure, fed by the caller's own facts" limit every other engine's own `plan*` function already accepts); an admin screen that already has both renders open side by side is trusted for the pairing, the same honest gap PR 474/475/476 left for their own first callers. `roles.ts` gains one new role, `couple_composition` — never a reference for further generation, the same reasoning PR 475/478's own `combo_gift_set_composition`/`set_try_on` already gave (`REFERENCE_ROLES` now excludes all three plus `primary_garment`, one widened `roles.test.ts` assertion, the length delta now `ASSET_ROLES.length - 4`). New `@extas/settings` registry file `registry-photoshoot-couple-composition.ts` (registry version 297): `studio.photoshoot.coupleCompositionEnabled` (off by default, CN-018, the same shape `comboGiftSetEnabled`/`sceneLibraryEnabled` already set) — no second setting, unlike PR 475/476's own layout/preset choice, since C7.13 names no owner-facing option for a couple shot, just an automatic composition; neither owner data. 15 new pure tests (`coupleCompositionStudio.test.ts`) plus one widened test in `roles.test.ts`, and 2 new pure tests in new `packages/settings/test/registry-photoshoot-couple-composition.test.ts` (registered at v297, store-scoped, bilingual, default valid; the feature switch off and never owner data). 6 new DB-backed tests in new `coupleCompositionStudio.db.test.ts` (a composition recorded and traced to the male render's own real original, tagged studio + both members; every "never invent" refusal shape — missing/never-generated/archived render on either member, naming each by name, both named together when both are missing; the same render refused as both members; a reader without `photoshoot.generate` refused; the real member renders and their own real originals left untouched; the reuse lookup scoped to its exact pair) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, same honest gap as PR 452–478; runs in CI. `@extas/photoshoot` 339 pure tests (191 DB-only skipped) and `@extas/settings` 4890 pure tests (18 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` on both packages), lint and the hardcode guard (0/3242 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change — the generic admin Settings screen already edits any JSON setting. Deliberately NOT here: wiring any job orchestrator or provider adapter to actually call this module (no caller exists yet, the same honest gap every other S24 engine's own first PR leaves); a new AI Cost Book sub-job row (C7.20's own fixed list of seven is not widened, the same reasoning PR 473/475/476's own headers already give); the occasion-scene suggester (C7.13's own last paragraph, item 37, still unbuilt). Register, README and `docs/stages/bn.json` updated in the same commit; `pnpm docs:stages` / `precommit-docs.sh` clean. ## PR 480

**Occasion scene suggester with previews and approval (V1 C7.22 item 37)**

**বাংলায়:** ছবি তোলার আগে স্টুডিও নিজেই তিনটা নামসহ দৃশ্যের অপশন দেখায় — শীতের সকাল, ঈদের সন্ধ্যা, ম্যাচ ডে, গরমকাল — পণ্যের ক্যাটাগরি আর মাস দেখে বেছে, যাতে শীতের জিনিস শীতেই শীতের দৃশ্য পায়। মালিক একটা বেছে নিতে পারেন, আরও অপশন চাইতে পারেন, বা বলতে পারেন কোনো দৃশ্য লাগবে না (সাদামাটা স্টুডিও)। দৃশ্য অনুমোদন আর সেভ করার কাজ আগেই তৈরি ছিল — এটা শুধু প্রস্তাব দেওয়ার অংশ। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ দিয়ে। এটা দিয়ে ফটোশুট স্টুডিওর সবগুলো পরিকল্পিত কাজ শেষ হলো।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: occasion scene suggester with previews and approval (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7.13 "Occasion scenes — and the system grooms the owner, not the other way round" — verbatim: "his head will not produce scene ideas on the spot, so the system must propose. Before generating, the system offers three scene options with small previews, each named and described in one line: 'Winter morning — soft fog, park path, cool tones' · 'Eid evening — warm light, decorated interior' · 'Match day — stadium tunnel, strong side light' · 'Summer — bright open street'. Suggestions are chosen from the product's category and the calendar, so winter items get winter scenes in winter. The owner picks one, asks for more options, or says no scene (plain studio). A demo frame is always shown before the full set is generated — he approves the look first, then it runs. Approved scenes are saved to the scene library and reused," C7.22 item 37; AI-2 lane, same worktree, branch `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling` kept as is per CN-044's standing lane instruction — no rename, built straight on PR 479's own tip, stacking PR 451–480): this PR's own honest scope is exactly C7.13's first three bullets — "the system must propose" — nothing more; the last two bullets are already built: `sceneLibrary.ts` (PR 476) already requires a real, approved demo frame before `recordSceneLibraryEntry` ever saves a scene, and its own `findLatestSceneLibraryEntry`/`listSceneLibrary` already reuse one; `isSceneLibraryKey`'s own module comment (PR 476) already anticipated this exact PR ("a custom scene key the occasion suggester … will mint … once the owner approves its own demo frame"). No migration. New `packages/photoshoot/src/occasionSceneSuggester.ts`: `OCCASION_SCENE_CATALOGUE` (C7.13's own four named occasions, verbatim, each minted as one of `sceneLibrary.ts`'s own well-formed custom slugs — `winter_morning`/`eid_evening`/`match_day`/`summer` — never a second, parallel scene vocabulary) and `OCCASION_SCENE_SUGGESTION_COUNT` (C7.13's own "offers three," a plain fixed fact like `MIN_COMBO_GIFT_SET_PIECES`, never a setting); `suggestOccasionScenes` (pure, no database, no clock read — fed by the caller's own month and the product's own category hints) scores each catalogue entry by calendar fit and category fit (Bangladesh's winter/summer months for the two seasonal occasions; Eid and match day carry no fixed months, since a lunar date and an event are never guessed as a Gregorian range, so they are always calendar-eligible and rank by category alone), sorts highest-first with ties kept in the catalogue's own fixed order — never random — and returns the top N; `excludeKeys` is C7.13's own "asks for more options," paging into the same catalogue rather than this module keeping session state. "Says no scene (plain studio)" is simply `sceneLibrary.ts`'s own pre-existing `studio_grey` preset, re-exported as `OCCASION_SCENE_NONE_KEY` so a caller never has to spell out or guess the string — not a new vocabulary. New `@extas/settings` registry file `registry-photoshoot-occasion-scene.ts` (registry version 298): `studio.photoshoot.occasionSceneSuggesterEnabled` (off by default, CN-018, the same shape every other S24 feature switch already set) — no second setting, since the catalogue and the count of three are both fixed facts, never an owner-editable number. 13 new pure tests (`occasionSceneSuggester.test.ts`: the catalogue verbatim with no duplicate keys, every key already a well-formed `sceneLibrary.ts` slug, bilingual descriptions; winter/summer items scoring top in their own season; a calendar-free occasion never excluded by the month; the default count of three; ties kept in catalogue order, never random; `excludeKeys` paging without inventing a new key; a month outside 1–12 refused) and 2 new pure tests in new `packages/settings/test/registry-photoshoot-occasion-scene.test.ts` (registered at v298, store-scoped, bilingual, default valid; the feature switch off and never owner data) — no DB-backed test file for this PR's own new code, the same "no recorder yet, part 1's own honest scope" shape PR 477 already set, since saving and reusing a scene is already `sceneLibrary.ts`'s own job. `@extas/photoshoot` 352 pure tests (191 DB-only skipped) and `@extas/settings` 4897 pure tests (18 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` on both packages), lint and the hardcode guard (0/3246 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change. Deliberately NOT here: any new recorder (PR 476 already owns saving/reusing a scene); wiring any admin screen or job orchestrator to call this module (no caller exists yet); a new AI Cost Book sub-job row. ## PR 539

**Virtual Photoshoot Studio — stage scope item, not itemised in the register (see C7)**

**বাংলায়:** মালিক নিজে একটা নমুনা পোজ বা স্টাইলিং ছবি দিলে, সেটা অনুযায়ী ছবি তৈরির পরিকল্পনা হয় — আর্কাইভ করা, AI-তৈরি বা ভুল কাজের জন্য ট্যাগ করা ছবি হলে তা সরাসরি বলে দেয়, নিজে থেকে ব্যবহার করে বসে না। একই টেমপ্লেট, পণ্য আর রঙের জন্য তৈরি পোজ সেট বা ভিডিও খুঁজে আবার ব্যবহার করার একটা ব্যবস্থাও হলো, যাতে দুইবার টাকা না যায়। ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, নিজের একটা সুইচ দিয়ে। এটা দিয়ে পুরো ফটোশুট স্টুডিও স্টেজ (৩৮/৩৮) সম্পূর্ণ হলো।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: style/pose reference and the AI pose/video asset-library reuse rule (S24 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C7, V2 18–19 Oct addition, §59 answer 59 — verbatim: "models may be brought in from outside or created in the backend, and when the owner supplies a sample pose or styling image the generated photograph follows it … Every AI pose set or video is kept in an asset library and reused for the same template + product + colours, never paid for twice"; AI-2 lane, same worktree, branch `pr-473-reflective-transparent-handling`, built straight on PR 448's own filing commit, stacking PR 451–480 plus the five register-only filings): two honestly-separate pieces, investigated before writing anything the same way PR 467/477/479 already did. (1) The sample pose/styling reference itself needed no new role or chokepoint — PR 444's own fixed taxonomy already has `context_reference` (`roles.ts`, its own doc comment already naming this exact PR) and PR 444's own `tagReferenceRole` already lets the owner tag any real, on-file photo with it; what was missing was only the plan. New `packages/photoshoot/src/styleReferenceStudio.ts`: `isUsableStyleReference` (pure — a real, non-archived, original photo actually tagged `context_reference`, never an AI-generated image and never a photo tagged for some other job) and `planStyleReferenceUsage` (pure, fed by the caller's own fact, the same shape every other engine's own `plan*` function already takes, but for an OPTIONAL input rather than a required one for the first time in this package: `'none'` when the owner supplied no reference at all — always allowed, never required; `'ready'` for a real, usable one; `'ignored_not_usable'`, named plainly rather than silently guessed at or applied anyway, for one named but not usable) plus `styleReferenceStatusMessage`, C7.6's own honesty rule applied to an optional input. No provider call exists anywhere in this package yet to literally make a generation "follow" a reference image — the same honest gap PR 460's recommendation note and PR 468's cost book already left for their own first reader; that wiring is a later PR's own job. (2) The AI pose/video asset-library reuse rule is cross-cutting every engine that might ever use a style reference, never a new engine of its own: `styleReferenceLibraryTag(templateKey, productId, colourKey)` (pure, deterministic, round-trippable, the same "free label, purely informational" shape `coupleCompositionMemberTag`/`setTryOnComponentTag` already set) and `findExistingStyleReferenceRender` (`photoshoot.read`, scoped to the exact template + product + colours, deliberately not scoped to one asset role since a reused pose set may come out of any engine this package has) let any engine's own existing `recordGeneratedAsset` call opt into this reuse by adding the one tag to its own `tags` — never a second recording chokepoint. New `@extas/settings` registry file `registry-photoshoot-style-reference.ts` (registry version 299): `studio.photoshoot.styleReferenceEnabled` (off by default, CN-018, the same shape every other S24 feature switch already set) — no second setting, since the reuse key's own three parts are a fixed mechanism, never an owner-editable number. 15 new pure tests (`styleReferenceStudio.test.ts`: the role is a real, already-existing one; every usability check — AI-generated, archived, wrong role, no role; the three plan states; the status messages; the tag's own determinism and non-collision across template/product/colour) and 2 new pure tests in new `packages/settings/test/registry-photoshoot-style-reference.test.ts` (registered at v299, store-scoped, bilingual, default valid; off and never owner data). 6 new DB-backed tests in new `styleReferenceStudio.db.test.ts` (null until a match exists; the newest match wins, never a different template/product/colour; an archived render is never reused; a real original photo is never reused even if it somehow carried the tag; store isolation; a reader without `photoshoot.read` refused) — DB tests skipped here, no Postgres in this sandbox, runs in CI. `@extas/photoshoot` 367 pure tests (197 DB-only skipped) and `@extas/settings` 4904 pure tests (18 DB-only skipped) stay green; typecheck (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` on both packages), lint and the hardcode guard (0/3250 files) clean on every touched file. No new admin page; no admin-guide change; no new AssetRole; no video asset kind (S25's own scope). This closes out the last named S24 PR — **S24 now stands at 38/38**, the whole stage's own scope built. Register, README and `docs/stages/bn.json` updated in the same commit; `pnpm docs:stages` / `precommit-docs.sh` clean. Per CN-044/CLAUDE.md's standing instruction, pushed and its pull request (GitHub #176) updated but NOT merged by this session — stacked on PR 451–480 plus the register filings, held for the FIX lane, which must also reconcile the separately-discovered main-branch divergence (duplicate PR 444 photoshoot foundation, `packages/auth/catalogue.ts` conflicts) before any merge.
  - GitHub pull request #176, 12 Nov
